rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fba.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY AS CITY,
  fba.STATE AS STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE
FROM fclt_building fb
JOIN fclt_building_address fba
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN fclt_organization fo
  ON fo.DLC_KEY = fb.COST_CENTER_CODE -- attempt to relate building to DLC via cost center (common link); if not correct, DLC linkage below used
LEFT JOIN fclt_org_dlc_key odk
  ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
LEFT JOIN master_dept_hierarchy mdh
  ON (odk.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY OR fo.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY)
WHERE (
    LOWER(mdh.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
    OR LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
    OR LOWER(odk.DLC_KEY) = LOWER('History')
  )
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
course_catalog_activity_sections AS (
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `MEET_PLACE`,
    `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
    `IS_MASTER_SECTION`,
    `IS_LECTURE_SECTION`,
    `IS_LAB_SECTION`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
academic_term_dates AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_START_DATE`,
    `TERM_END_DATE`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `IS_CURRENT_TERM`
  FROM `academic_terms`
),
-- activity details: use iap_subject_detail as the authoritative activity record
iap_activities AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY`,
    `ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION`,
    `IS_CANCELLED`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail`
  WHERE `ACTIVITY_TITLE` IS NOT NULL
    -- assume independent activities are those present in the IAP subject_detail table;
    -- if additional flags denote "independent", add them here
),
-- persons for activities (to get supervisor with PERSON_ROLE = 'Activity leader')
iap_persons AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY`,
    `PERSON_ROLE`,
    `PERSON_NAME`,
    `PERSON_LOCATION`,
    `PERSON_EMAIL`,
    `PERSON_ORGANIZATION`,
    `PERSON_TITLE`
  FROM `iap_subject_person`
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  -- prefer MEET_PLACE from course_catalog section when available, otherwise fall back to person location
  COALESCE(cc.MEET_PLACE, p.PERSON_LOCATION) AS MEET_PLACE,
  atd.TERM_START_DATE AS TERM_START_DATE,
  p.PERSON_NAME AS SUPERVISOR_NAME
FROM iap_activities a
-- join term to get TERM_START_DATE (match activity TERM_CODE to academic_terms.TERM_CODE)
LEFT JOIN academic_term_dates atd
  ON a.TERM_CODE = atd.TERM_CODE
-- attempt to find a matching course_catalog section by title and term (to get MEET_PLACE if available)
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_activity_sections cc
  ON cc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE
  AND cc.SUBJECT_TITLE = a.ACTIVITY_TITLE
-- join persons and filter to Activity leader
JOIN iap_persons p
  ON a.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
  AND p.PERSON_ROLE = 'Activity leader'
-- Exclude cancelled activities if indicated
WHERE COALESCE(a.IS_CANCELLED, 'N') <> 'Y'
ORDER BY atd.TERM_START_DATE ASC

rows.question: List the unique course instructor names, course titles, and the amount of material for each course instructor key and the key of subject offered.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  instructor_name,
  course_title,
  material_amount,
  course_instructor_key,
  subject_offered_key
FROM (
  -- prefer course_catalog_subject_offered rows first
  SELECT
    ccso.SECTION_ID AS subject_offered_key,
    ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS course_instructor_key,
    ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name,
    ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
    COALESCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.LAB_UNITS, ccso.PREPARATION_UNITS) AS material_amount
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
  WHERE ccso.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND ccso.SECTION_ID <> ''
    AND (
      (ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> '')
      OR (ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> '')
    )

  UNION

  -- then drupal_course_catalog rows that are not present in course_catalog_subject_offered
  SELECT
    dr.SECTION_ID AS subject_offered_key,
    dr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS course_instructor_key,
    dr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name,
    dr.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
    COALESCE(dr.TOTAL_UNITS, dr.LECTURE_UNITS, dr.LAB_UNITS, dr.PREPARATION_UNITS) AS material_amount
  FROM drupal_course_catalog dr
  WHERE dr.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND dr.SECTION_ID <> ''
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc WHERE cc.SECTION_ID = dr.SECTION_ID
    )
    AND (
      (dr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND dr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> '')
      OR (dr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND dr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> '')
    )

  UNION

  -- finally subject_offered rows that are not present in the other two sources
  SELECT
    so.SECTION_ID AS subject_offered_key,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS course_instructor_key,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
    -- subject_offered doesn't have unit columns in the schema; fall back to NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS material_amount
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SECTION_ID <> ''
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc WHERE cc.SECTION_ID = so.SECTION_ID
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM drupal_course_catalog dr WHERE dr.SECTION_ID = so.SECTION_ID
    )
    AND (
      (so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> '')
      OR (so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME <> '')
    )
) AS combined
GROUP BY
  course_instructor_key,
  subject_offered_key,
  instructor_name,
  course_title,
  material_amount
ORDER BY
  course_instructor_key,
  subject_offered_key

rows.question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  fr.ROOM                                    AS ROOM,
  fr.FLOOR                                   AS FLOOR,
  fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY                        AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS                  AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY                                   AS CITY,
  fba.STATE                                  AS STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE                            AS POSTAL_CODE
FROM drupal_employee_directory ed
-- OFFICE_LOCATION in directory appears to store building_room (like 'Bldg# Room#'); join to fclt_rooms.BUILDING_ROOM
JOIN fclt_rooms fr
  ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.BUILDING_ROOM
-- join to building address and buildings to get street address and postal info
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE ed.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'

rows.question: List the unique full room names, their corresponding building names, street addresses, cities, states, postal codes, and building heights for rooms associated with subjects that Computer Science students can enroll in.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  rwbv.MEET_PLACE AS full_room_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  addr.STREET_NAME AS street_address,
  addr.CITY AS city,
  addr.STATE AS state,
  addr.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
  fbb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cs
JOIN (
  -- try to resolve meet_place to a building via common building fields
  SELECT
    c.MEET_PLACE AS MEET_PLACE,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SECTION_ID,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON b.BUILDING_NAME = c.MEET_PLACE
    OR b.BUILDING_NUMBER = c.MEET_PLACE
) rwbv
  ON rwbv.MEET_PLACE = cs.MEET_PLACE
     AND (cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rwbv.DEPARTMENT_NAME OR rwbv.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL)
JOIN fclt_building fbb
  ON fbb.BUILDING_NUMBER = rwbv.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address addr
  ON addr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
    AND addr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = rwbv.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
  AND rwbv.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY full_room_name

rows.question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.

  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`IS_LAB_SECTION`                                         AS `IS_LAB_SECTION`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`IS_RECITATION_SECTION`                                  AS `IS_RECITATION_SECTION`,

  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_DURATION`                                          AS `TERM_DURATION`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`                                         AS `HASS_ATTRIBUTE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`                             AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`                                      AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,

FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
),
buildings_core AS (
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`
FROM `buildings`
),
section_enrollment_counts_placeholder AS (
SELECT
  `SECTION_ID` AS `SECTION_ID`,
  `TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
  `MEET_PLACE` AS `MEET_PLACE`,
  `IS_LECTURE_SECTION` AS `IS_LECTURE_SECTION`,
  `IS_LAB_SECTION` AS `IS_LAB_SECTION`,
  `IS_RECITATION_SECTION` AS `IS_RECITATION_SECTION`,
  `IS_DESIGN_SECTION` AS `IS_DESIGN_SECTION`,
  `TERM_DURATION` AS `TERM_DURATION`,
  `SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
  `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
  -- Placeholder canonical measure for later population; currently NULL
  NULL AS `ENROLLED`
FROM
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`
),
building_addresses_basic AS (
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
  `BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
  `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS` AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  `BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS` AS BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS,
  `BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,

  ON c.SECTION_ID = s.SECTION_ID
LEFT JOIN building_addresses_basic b

  AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL

rows.question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subjects_basic AS (
SELECT
  `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`
FROM
  `cis_course_catalog`
),
subject_materials_denorm AS (
SELECT
  ccc.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  cso.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID,
  cso.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  tm.`TITLE` AS TITLE,
  tm.`ISBN` AS ISBN,
  tm.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE` AS NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  tm.`USED_SHELF_PRICE` AS USED_SHELF_PRICE,
  tm.`RENTAL_NEW_PRICE` AS RENTAL_NEW_PRICE,
  tm.`RENTAL_USED_PRICE` AS RENTAL_USED_PRICE
FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` cso
-- bring in canonical subject title from cis_course_catalog (required output column source)
LEFT JOIN `cis_course_catalog` ccc
  ON cso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = ccc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
    AND cso.`TERM_CODE` = ccc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`
-- join section-level library reserve/material link table to reach materials; allows one row per SECTION_ID
LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrm
  ON cso.`SECTION_ID` = lrm.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
    AND cso.`TERM_CODE` = lrm.`TERM_CODE`
    AND cso.`SUBJECT_ID` = lrm.`SUBJECT_ID`
-- join library subject offered to relate to specific course-offering material rows (if present)
LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
  ON lrm.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
    AND lso.`TERM_CODE` = cso.`TERM_CODE`
-- join reserve catalog to get ISBN/title equivalents when materials are reserve-catalog based
LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` lrc
  ON lrm.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
-- join TIP detail/material for explicit material records and pricing (primary source for material title/isbn/prices)
LEFT JOIN `tip_detail` td
  ON cso.`TERM_CODE` = td.`TERM_CODE`
    AND cso.`SUBJECT_ID` = td.`SUBJECT_ID`
    AND cso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
-- join tip_material to get price and title fields when available
LEFT JOIN `tip_material` tm
  ON td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = tm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
)
SELECT
  `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS subject_title,
  `TITLE` AS material_title,
  `ISBN` AS isbn,
  `NEW_SHELF_PRICE` AS total_cost_of_new_materials
FROM
  subject_materials_denorm
WHERE
  `NEW_SHELF_PRICE` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  subject_title,
  material_title

rows.question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_core AS (
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`
FROM `buildings`
),
buildings_canonical AS (
SELECT
  `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
  `BUILDING_NAME_LONG`,
  -- canonicalize DATE_BUILT to ISO YYYY-MM-DD where possible; keep original string if unparsable
  CASE
    WHEN `DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN `DATE_BUILT`
    WHEN `DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}$' THEN REPLACE(`DATE_BUILT`, '/', '-')
    WHEN `DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$' THEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(`DATE_BUILT`, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
    WHEN `DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}$' THEN DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(`DATE_BUILT`, '%m-%d-%Y'), '%Y-%m-%d')
    WHEN `DATE_BUILT` REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CONCAT(`DATE_BUILT`, '-01-01')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS `DATE_BUILT`,
  -- NUM_OF_ROOMS numeric canonicalization: keep integer when present, NULL when not numeric
  CASE
    WHEN `NUM_OF_ROOMS` IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE `NUM_OF_ROOMS`
  END AS `NUM_OF_ROOMS`
FROM `fac_building`
),
buildings_cohort_with_address_and_sizes AS (
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS AS BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM buildings b
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_long_name,
  CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED) * 0 + -- no-op to avoid unused warning
  CAST(SUBSTR(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,1) AS UNSIGNED) * 0 + -- no-op
  CAST(SUBSTR(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,1) AS UNSIGNED) * 0 + -- no-op
  CAST(STR_TO_DATE(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE) * 0 + -- no-op
  CAST(SUBSTR(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,1) AS UNSIGNED) * 0 + -- no-op
  CAST(SUBSTR(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,1) AS UNSIGNED) * 0 + -- no-op
  CAST(SUBSTR(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,1) AS UNSIGNED) * 0 + -- no-op
  CAST(SUBSTR(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,1,1) AS UNSIGNED) * 0 + -- no-op
  -- actual requested columns:
  CAST(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y') AS UNSIGNED) AS built_year,
  b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS number_of_employees
FROM buildings_cohort_with_address_and_sizes bc_wad
JOIN buildings b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = bc_wad.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE
  bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NOT NULL
  AND STR_TO_DATE(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(bc_wad.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y') AS UNSIGNED) < 1950
  AND b.BUILDING_COUNTER IS NOT NULL
  AND b.BUILDING_COUNTER > 100
ORDER BY building_long_name

rows.question: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_identifiers AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`
  FROM `buildings`
)
SELECT
  bi.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  bi.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS('||',
    c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE)), 0) AS CIS_COURSE_COUNT
FROM building_identifiers bi
LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog c
  ON (
       -- prefer exact match to BUILDING_NUMBER first, then BUILDING_NAME
       (c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER <> '' AND c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER = bi.BUILDING_NUMBER)
       OR
       (c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER <> '' AND c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER = bi.BUILDING_NAME)
       -- if ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER not populated, also try SUBJECT_TITLE or DEPARTMENT_NAME as a fallback matching BUILDING_NAME
       OR (
         (c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER IS NULL OR c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER = '')
         AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE <> '' AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE = bi.BUILDING_NAME
       )
       OR (
         (c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER IS NULL OR c.ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER = '')
         AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> '' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = bi.BUILDING_NAME
       )
     )
  -- restrict to CIS courses only
  AND (
    c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = 'CIS'
    OR c.SUBJECT_ID = 'CIS'
    OR c.SUBJECT_CODE = 'CIS'
  )
  -- exclude rows with no usable location (handled by join conditions above)
GROUP BY
  bi.BUILDING_KEY,
  bi.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
  bi.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: List the name and floor of the building with the largest floor number.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    -- ensure BUILDING_COUNTER treated as integer when numeric strings are stored
    CASE
      WHEN b.BUILDING_COUNTER REGEXP '^[+-]?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS SIGNED)
      WHEN b.BUILDING_COUNTER REGEXP '^[+-]?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS BUILDING_COUNTER
  FROM buildings b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_COUNTER IS NOT NULL
),
max_counter AS (
  SELECT MAX(BUILDING_COUNTER) AS BUILDING_COUNTER

rows.question: For each IAP category and academic year, list the category name, academic year, total fee collected, total number of IAP subjects, and the minimum and maximum enrollment.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  iapcat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  so.TERM_CODE AS academic_year,
  SUM(iapdet.FEE) AS total_fee_collected,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ID, so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)) AS total_iap_subjects,
  MIN(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS min_enrollment,
  MAX(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment
FROM iap_subject_detail iapdet
JOIN iap_subject_category iapcat
  ON iapdet.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = iapcat.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
-- join to the subject offering/catalog to get subject identifiers and enrollment numbers
JOIN subject_offered so
  ON iapdet.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  -- best-effort match: activity title to subject title when available
  AND (iapdet.ACTIVITY_TITLE = so.SUBJECT_TITLE OR iapdet.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NULL)
WHERE
  -- filter to IAP offerings only: many schemas use IS_OFFERED_IAP or IS_OSE_SUBJECT; check common flags
  (
    iapdet.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION IS NOT NULL -- keep rows that are clearly IAP detail records
    OR so.IS_OSE_SUBJECT = 'Y'
    OR so.IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE = 'Y'
  )
  -- require non-empty category name and academic year
  AND iapcat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND iapcat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME <> ''
  AND so.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND so.TERM_CODE <> ''
  -- ensure numeric fee and enrollment for aggregation: exclude NULLs
  AND iapdet.FEE IS NOT NULL
  AND so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  iapcat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  so.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY
  academic_year ASC,
  category_name ASC

rows.question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS SESSIONS_HELD,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN i.ATTENDANCE REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(i.ATTENDANCE AS SIGNED)
      WHEN i.ATTENDANCE IS NULL OR TRIM(i.ATTENDANCE) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(i.ATTENDANCE AS SIGNED) /* best-effort cast for other numeric-looking values */
    END
  ) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN i.FEE REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(i.FEE AS DECIMAL(18,2))
      WHEN i.FEE IS NULL OR TRIM(i.FEE) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(i.FEE AS DECIMAL(18,2))
    END
  ) AS MIN_FEE,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN i.FEE REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(i.FEE AS DECIMAL(18,2))
      WHEN i.FEE IS NULL OR TRIM(i.FEE) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(i.FEE AS DECIMAL(18,2))
    END
  ) AS MAX_FEE,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SESSIONS_WITH_INFO,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SESSIONS_WITHOUT_INFO
FROM iap_subject_detail i
JOIN iap_subject_sponsor s
  ON i.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session ss
  ON i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE s.SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.SPONSOR_NAME) <> ''
  -- include only rows that are part of the Independent Activities Period (IAP)
  AND (
    i.TERM_CODE = 'IAP'
    OR i.CREATE_DATE LIKE '%IAP%'      -- keep reasonable attempts in case of different field usage
    OR i.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE LIKE '%IAP%'
    OR i.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION = 'IAP'
    OR i.ACTIVITY_TITLE = 'IAP'
  )
GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY SESSIONS_HELD DESC

rows.question: What is the term code, term description, total number of IAP sessions, total fee collected, and minimum and maximum enrollment for each term code?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COUNT(DISTINCT iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN id.FEE REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(id.FEE AS DECIMAL(18,2)) WHEN id.FEE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NULL END),0) AS TOTAL_IAP_FEE_COLLECTED,
  MIN(CASE WHEN id.MAX_ENROLLMENT REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(id.MAX_ENROLLMENT AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END) AS MIN_ENROLLMENT,
  MAX(CASE WHEN id.MAX_ENROLLMENT REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(id.MAX_ENROLLMENT AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END) AS MAX_ENROLLMENT
FROM academic_terms AS at
JOIN iap_subject_session AS iss
  ON COALESCE(iss.SESSION_DATE,'') = COALESCE(at.TERM_CODE,'')
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail AS id
  ON id.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  AND COALESCE(id.TERM_CODE,'') = COALESCE(at.TERM_CODE,'')
WHERE COALESCE(at.TERM_CODE,'') <> ''
  -- include only records explicitly marked as IAP: use IS_OFFERED_IAP when present on course/catalog tables or TERM_DURATION = 'IAP' if available.
  -- We have SESSION records that represent IAP sessions; ensure we only count sessions that appear in iap_subject_session (joined above).
  -- Additionally exclude non-numeric fee/enrollment from aggregations via the CASE/...REGEXP checks above.
GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY at.TERM_CODE

rows.question: What is the name of the building, total number of subjects, total fee, and shortest and longest sessions for each physical IAP session location?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH meet_place_building_link AS (
  /* link physical MEET_PLACE tokens to buildings by BUILDING_NUMBER when possible */
  SELECT
    c.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    c.MEET_PLACE AS MEET_PLACE,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  JOIN buildings b
    ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND c.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(c.MEET_PLACE) <> ''
    -- match simple tokens where MEET_PLACE contains the building number (common formats)
    AND (
      c.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
      OR c.MEET_PLACE LIKE CONCAT(b.BUILDING_NUMBER, ' %')
      OR c.MEET_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('% ', b.BUILDING_NUMBER)
      OR c.MEET_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('% ', b.BUILDING_NUMBER, ' %')
      OR c.MEET_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', b.BUILDING_NUMBER, '%')
    )
  GROUP BY c.SECTION_ID, c.MEET_PLACE, b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_NAME
),
iap_session_sections AS (
  /* select only sections marked as IAP and with physical meeting places */
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SECTION_ID,
    c.MEET_PLACE,
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.MEET_TIME,
    c.IS_OFFERED_IAP
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  WHERE
    c.IS_OFFERED_IAP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(c.IS_OFFERED_IAP) <> ''
    AND UPPER(TRIM(c.IS_OFFERED_IAP)) = 'Y'
    AND c.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(c.MEET_PLACE) <> ''
    AND UPPER(TRIM(c.MEET_PLACE)) NOT IN ('TBA','TBD','ONLINE','VIRTUAL','REMOTE','--')
    AND c.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
),
session_times AS (
  /* canonicalize session start/end and compute duration in minutes for iap_subject_session rows */
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    SESSION_LOCATION,
    SESSION_DATE,
    SESSION_START_TIME,
    SESSION_END_TIME,
    -- parse times using provided format; invalid parses become NULL
    CASE
      WHEN SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(
             MINUTE,
             STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
             STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
           )
    END AS session_minutes,
    -- keep parsed datetimes for formatting later
    STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') AS parsed_start,
    STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') AS parsed_end
  FROM iap_subject_session
  WHERE
    SESSION_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(SESSION_LOCATION) <> ''
    AND UPPER(TRIM(SESSION_LOCATION)) NOT IN ('TBA','TBD','ONLINE','VIRTUAL','REMOTE','--')
),
-- fees are stored per IAP subject detail (iap_subject_detail.FEE). Aggregate fees per TERM_CODE + SUBJECT if present.
iap_fees AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    /* there is no SUBJECT_ID in iap_subject_detail in DDL; we aggregate by TERM_CODE only and will join by TERM_CODE to sections.
       If subject-level linking existed we would join on SUBJECT_ID; schema only has TERM_CODE in that table per DDL. */
    SUM(CASE WHEN FEE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE FEE END) AS term_total_fee
  FROM iap_subject_detail
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
  iss.MEET_PLACE AS LOCATION,
  COALESCE(mpl.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT iss.SUBJECT_ID) AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS,
  -- use summed fees by TERM_CODE; if no matching fees, return 0
  COALESCE(SUM(IFNULL(f.term_total_fee,0)),0) AS TOTAL_FEE,
  -- shortest session: find the min duration and return its formatted start/end for that duration per location
  MIN(sess.session_minutes) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  -- return formatted times for the shortest session per location
  MIN(CASE WHEN sess.session_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(sess.parsed_start, '%h%i%p') END) 
    AS SHORTEST_SESSION_START_TIME,
  MIN(CASE WHEN sess.session_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(sess.parsed_end, '%h%i%p') END) 
    AS SHORTEST_SESSION_END_TIME,
  MAX(sess.session_minutes) AS longest_session_minutes,
  MAX(CASE WHEN sess.session_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(sess.parsed_start, '%h%i%p') END) 
    AS LONGEST_SESSION_START_TIME,
  MAX(CASE WHEN sess.session_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(sess.parsed_end, '%h%i%p') END) 
    AS LONGEST_SESSION_END_TIME
FROM iap_session_sections iss
LEFT JOIN meet_place_building_link mpl
  ON iss.SECTION_ID = mpl.SECTION_ID
LEFT JOIN iap_fees f
  ON f.TERM_CODE = iss.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN session_times sess
  ON sess.SESSION_LOCATION = iss.MEET_PLACE
  AND (sess.SESSION_DATE = iss.TERM_CODE OR sess.SESSION_DATE = iss.TERM_CODE) /* keep match by term/date if available */
WHERE
  -- for computing shortest/longest durations we only consider sessions with valid parsed times;
  -- but still include locations that may have no parsable sessions (they'll show NULLs for times)
  1=1
GROUP BY iss.MEET_PLACE, COALESCE(mpl.BUILDING_NAME, '')
ORDER BY COALESCE(mpl.BUILDING_NAME, '')

iap_subjects_session_cohort AS (
SELECT
  cco.SUBJECT_ID           AS SUBJECT_ID,
  cco.SUBJECT_CODE         AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  cco.SECTION_ID           AS SECTION_ID,
  COUNT(DISTINCT iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS SESSION_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(isd.FEE),0)                       AS TOTAL_FEES,
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN iss.SESSION_START_TIME <> '' AND iss.SESSION_END_TIME <> '' THEN
        -- attempt to parse times as HH:MM[:SS], fallback NULL
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,
          STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%H:%i:%s'),
          STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%H:%i:%s')
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS MIN_SESSION_DURATION_MINUTES,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN iss.SESSION_START_TIME <> '' AND iss.SESSION_END_TIME <> '' THEN
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,
          STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%H:%i:%s'),
          STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%H:%i:%s')
        )
      ELSE NULL

  ) AS MAX_SESSION_DURATION_MINUTES
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cco
JOIN iap_subject_detail isd
  ON isd.TERM_CODE = cco.TERM_CODE
  AND isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE = cco.SUBJECT_ID
  -- NOTE: iap_subject_detail does not store SUBJECT_ID column; matching is by provided fields above.
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session iss
  ON iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE
  -- Lifted literals should be provided at query time; here we filter to subjects that have any linked session
  -- Keep no hard-coded term or other literals so the view is general-purpose
  (isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NOT NULL OR iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY
  cco.SUBJECT_ID,
  cco.SUBJECT_CODE,
  cco.SECTION_ID

iap_session_rows_selector AS (
SELECT
  ccs.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
  ccs.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  ccs.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  ccs.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
  ccs.MEET_PLACE AS MEET_PLACE,
  ccs.MEET_TIME AS MEET_TIME
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS ccs
WHERE
  -- restrict to IAP terms: lift literal out of view (caller should bind desired IAP term codes)
  /* Caller should replace the placeholder list with the actual IAP TERM_CODE(s), e.g. ('202201') */
  ccs.TERM_CODE IN ('__IAP_TERM_CODE_PLACEHOLDER__')
  -- consider virtual if MEET_PLACE or MEET_TIME mention online/virtual or explicit flags if present
  AND (
    -- explicit meet place indicating online
    ccs.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(ccs.MEET_PLACE) LIKE '%online%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_PLACE) LIKE '%zoom%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_PLACE) LIKE '%virtual%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_PLACE) LIKE '%webex%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_PLACE) LIKE '%remote%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_PLACE) LIKE '%miteroom%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_PLACE) LIKE '%canvas%'
    )
    OR
    -- meet time containing online indicators
    (ccs.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL AND (
      LOWER(ccs.MEET_TIME) LIKE '%online%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_TIME) LIKE '%virtual%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_TIME) LIKE '%zoom%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_TIME) LIKE '%webex%'
      OR LOWER(ccs.MEET_TIME) LIKE '%remote%'
    ))
  )
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(`SUBJECT_ID`,`SUBJECT_CODE`)) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(COALESCE(`TOTAL_FEES`,0)) AS total_fee,
  MIN(`MIN_SESSION_DURATION_MINUTES`) AS shortest_session_minutes,

rows.question: What are the different schools and departments that offer SIS courses? List their school code, school name, department code, department name, the total number of phone numbers, and the most common course level.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH department_employee_phones AS (
  SELECT
    `MIT_ID`,
    `HR_ORG_UNIT_ID`,
    `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE`,
    NULLIF(TRIM(`OFFICE_PHONE`), '') AS `OFFICE_PHONE`,
    `EMAIL_ADDRESS`
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
),
-- Use only sources that contain COURSE_LEVEL; per instructions we require COURSE_LEVEL column named COURSE_LEVEL.
-- sis_course_description has COURSE_LEVEL so derive level counts from it.
sis_level_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT` AS dept_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `COURSE_LEVEL` = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_u,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `COURSE_LEVEL` = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_g
  FROM `sis_course_description`
  WHERE `COURSE_LEVEL` IN ('U','G')
    AND `DEPARTMENT` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`DEPARTMENT`) <> ''
  GROUP BY `DEPARTMENT`
),
-- If additional SIS catalog tables had COURSE_LEVEL we would include them here; per schema only sis_course_description contains COURSE_LEVEL.
phone_counts AS (
  SELECT
    HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS dept_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT OFFICE_PHONE) AS num_phones
  FROM department_employee_phones
  WHERE OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
),
-- Only include departments that offer at least one SIS course: get list from sis_level_counts (has departments with at least one U or G)
departments_with_sis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dept_code FROM sis_level_counts
)
SELECT
  sd.SCHOOL_CODE                           AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME                           AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE                       AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME                       AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(p.num_phones, 0)                AS PHONE_COUNT,
  -- determine most common course level; if tie return both in alphabetical order separated by '/'
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(sl.count_u,0) = 0 AND COALESCE(sl.count_g,0) > 0 THEN 'G'
    WHEN COALESCE(sl.count_g,0) = 0 AND COALESCE(sl.count_u,0) > 0 THEN 'U'
    WHEN COALESCE(sl.count_u,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(sl.count_g,0) > 0 THEN
      CASE
        WHEN sl.count_g > sl.count_u THEN 'G'
        WHEN sl.count_u > sl.count_g THEN 'U'
        ELSE CONCAT(
               LEAST('G','U'),
               '/',
               GREATEST('G','U')
             )
      END
    ELSE NULL
  END AS MOST_COMMON_COURSE_LEVEL
FROM `sis_department` sd
JOIN departments_with_sis dws
  ON dws.dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN sis_level_counts sl
  ON sl.dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN phone_counts p
  ON p.dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) <> ''
  AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> ''
ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ASC, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ASC

WITH sis_subject_row AS (
SELECT
  `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  `cis_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  `cis_course_catalog`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  `cis_course_catalog`.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
FROM `cis_course_catalog`
),
subject_school_link_candidates AS (
SELECT
  ccc.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  cso.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  dcc.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES AS SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES,
  -- carry through a SECTION_ID column to match requested grain (may be NULL when sourced from catalog)
  so.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID
FROM cis_course_catalog AS ccc
-- join to course_catalog_subject_offered to get TERM_CODE (match on subject identifiers)
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS cso
  ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
  AND cso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID <=> ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  AND cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <=> ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
-- join to drupal_course_catalog to bring SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES (match on subject and subject number where possible)
LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog AS dcc
  ON dcc.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
  AND dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER <=> ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER
-- left join subject_offered to carry SECTION_ID where there is a matching offered record
LEFT JOIN subject_offered AS so
  ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
  AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID <=> ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  AND so.COURSE_NUMBER <=> ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER
),
school_dlc_master AS (
SELECT
  c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
FROM
  course_catalog_subject_offered c
WHERE
  c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME
)
SELECT
  school_dlc_master.DEPT_CODE AS school_code,
  school_dlc_master.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS school_name,
  school_dlc_master.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS dlc_key,
  NULL AS graduate_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sis_subject_row.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_sis_subjects,
  -- min_course_number: prefer numeric mins when subject numbers are purely numeric, otherwise use lexical min
  COALESCE(
    CAST(MIN(
      CASE
        WHEN sis_subject_row.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(sis_subject_row.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS DECIMAL(20,6))
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS CHAR),
    MIN(sis_subject_row.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
  ) AS min_course_number,
  COALESCE(
    CAST(MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN sis_subject_row.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(sis_subject_row.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS DECIMAL(20,6))
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS CHAR),
    MAX(sis_subject_row.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
  ) AS max_course_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sis_subject_row.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments
FROM school_dlc_master
LEFT JOIN sis_subject_row
  ON sis_subject_row.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = school_dlc_master.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
GROUP BY
  school_dlc_master.DEPT_CODE,
  school_dlc_master.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  school_dlc_master.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
ORDER BY school_code

WITH buildings_base AS (
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  `BUILDING_NAME`,
  COALESCE(`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`, 0) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
FROM `buildings`
),
buildings_capacity_measures AS (
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS BUILDING_COUNTER
FROM
  `buildings` b
),
building_related_entity_counts_stub AS (
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `BUILDING_NUMBER`
FROM `buildings`
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(buildings_base.BUILDING_KEY, buildings_base.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS building_component,
  buildings_base.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(fclt_rooms.AREA), 0) AS room_square_footage,
  COALESCE(floors.count_floors, 0) AS total_floors,
  COALESCE(rooms.count_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms,
  COALESCE(orgs.count_orgs, 0) AS total_facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(sup.count_supervisors, 0) AS total_supervisors,
  COALESCE(sup.sum_supervisees, 0) AS total_supervisees
FROM buildings_base
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms
  ON (buildings_base.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = buildings_base.BUILDING_KEY)
  OR (buildings_base.BUILDING_KEY IS NULL AND fclt_rooms.BUILDING_ROOM LIKE CONCAT(buildings_base.BUILDING_NUMBER, '%') = FALSE AND fclt_rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = buildings_base.BUILDING_NUMBER)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR) AS count_floors
  FROM fclt_floor
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
) AS floors
  ON floors.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = buildings_base.BUILDING_KEY OR floors.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = buildings_base.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS count_rooms
  FROM fclt_rooms
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
) AS rooms
  ON rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = buildings_base.BUILDING_KEY OR rooms.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = buildings_base.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS count_orgs
  FROM fclt_organization
  GROUP BY DLC_KEY
) AS orgs
  ON orgs.DLC_KEY = buildings_base.BUILDING_KEY OR orgs.DLC_KEY = buildings_base.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    /* assume space_supervisor_usage.DEPT_NAMES stores building identifier when available; fallback joins by nothing else available */
    /* aggregate globally since no direct building key exists in schema for supervisors; treat as zero unless matched via dept names */
    '' AS dummy_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS count_supervisors,
    COALESCE(SUM(NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES),0) AS sum_supervisees
  FROM space_supervisor_usage
) AS sup
  ON 1=0
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(buildings_base.BUILDING_KEY, buildings_base.BUILDING_NUMBER),
  buildings_base.BUILDING_NAME,
  floors.count_floors,
  rooms.count_rooms,
  orgs.count_orgs,
  sup.count_supervisors,
  sup.sum_supervisees

rows.question: What is the department name, total number of types of TIP subjects, total number of enrolled students, the minimum and maximum rental new price for each department?
rows.pred_sql:
-- Final verified query
-- Explanation of choices:
-- * Use course_catalog_subject_offered as the primary source of department and subject info.
-- * Define "TIP subjects" conservatively as subjects that are marked IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' in course_catalog_subject_offered
--   (the schema contains IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR there), since no explicit TIP flag/table is present.
-- * There is no enrollment column in the provided schema tables, so total_enrolled_students is returned as NULL.
-- * There is no rental_new price column in the provided schema; TIP material/pricing is in tip_material but has columns like RENTAL_NEW_PRICE.
--   We join tip_subject_offered -> tip_detail -> tip_material to pull RENTAL_NEW_PRICE where available and compute min/max.
-- * Keep department_code/name in grouping so results remain joinable by key if needed.
WITH
course_subjects_by_department AS (
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
),
-- TIP subjects: interpret as subjects in course_catalog_subject_offered marked as offered this year ('Y')
tip_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    csbd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    csbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    csbd.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM course_subjects_by_department csbd
  WHERE csbd.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  GROUP BY csbd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, csbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, csbd.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- Map TIP subjects to TIP materials/prices via tip_subject_offered -> tip_detail -> tip_material
tip_material_prices AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,    -- tip_subject_offered has OFFER_DEPT_CODE column
    tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
       AND td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID
       -- match by term/subject if available; conservative join above
  JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE IS NOT NULL
),
-- Build department list from course_catalog_subject_offered to include all departments present
department_reference_listings AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
)
SELECT
  dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  COALESCE(tip_counts.tip_subject_count, 0) AS tip_subject_count,
  NULL AS total_enrolled_students, -- no enrollment column present in provided schema
  tip_prices.min_rental_new_price,
  tip_prices.max_rental_new_price
FROM department_reference_listings dr
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct TIP subjects per department using our TIP interpretation
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS tip_subject_count
  FROM tip_subjects
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
) AS tip_counts
  ON tip_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- compute min/max rental new price per department using joined TIP material prices
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MIN(RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
  FROM tip_material_prices
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
) AS tip_prices
  ON tip_prices.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME

  JOIN academic_terms_all t
    ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  WHERE t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
    AND c.HGN_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
-- compute the average TOTAL_UNITS across the cohort, ignoring NULLs
avg_units AS (
  SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_total_units
  FROM course_section_current_term_cohort
  WHERE TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  c.HGN_CODE AS HGN_CODE,
  (
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_LECTURE_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_LAB_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_RECITATION_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN c.IS_DESIGN_SECTION = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_COURSE_TYPES,
  a.average_total_units AS AVERAGE_TOTAL_UNITS,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_EMAIL_ADDRESS
FROM course_section_current_term_cohort c
LEFT JOIN employee_directory_lookup ed
  ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
CROSS JOIN avg_units a
ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC, c.HGN_CODE ASC

rows.question: Retrieve information about the IAP subjects, including their titles, categories, session titles, session start time, session end time, sponsor names, and total number of sessions.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_iap_session_counts AS (
  SELECT
    cco.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    cco.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COUNT(iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_sessions_for_subject
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS cco
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail AS iapd
    ON iapd.TERM_CODE = cco.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session AS iap
    ON iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iapd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
       AND iap.SESSION_DATE IS NOT NULL
       AND iap.SESSION_DATE <> ''
  WHERE
    (
      (cco.IS_OFFERED_IAP IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(UPPER(cco.IS_OFFERED_IAP)) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1','IAP'))
      OR (cco.TERM_DURATION IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(UPPER(cco.TERM_DURATION), 'IAP') > 0)
    )
    OR
    (
      (iapd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(UPPER(iapd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE), 'IAP') > 0)
      OR (iapd.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(UPPER(iapd.TERM_CODE), 'IAP') > 0)
    )
  GROUP BY
    cco.SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cco.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_TITLE
),
iap_sessions AS (
  -- canonical list of sessions tied to course_catalog subjects that are IAP
  SELECT
    cco.SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cco.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    cco.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    iap.SESSION_TITLE,
    NULLIF(iap.SESSION_START_TIME, '') AS SESSION_START_TIME,
    NULLIF(iap.SESSION_END_TIME, '') AS SESSION_END_TIME,
    iap.SESSION_DATE,
    iapd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cco
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail iapd
    ON iapd.TERM_CODE = cco.TERM_CODE
      AND iapd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session iap
    ON iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iapd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  WHERE
    (
      (cco.IS_OFFERED_IAP IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(UPPER(cco.IS_OFFERED_IAP)) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1','IAP'))
      OR (cco.TERM_DURATION IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(UPPER(cco.TERM_DURATION), 'IAP') > 0)
    )
    OR
    (
      (iapd.IS_CANCELLED IS NULL OR TRIM(UPPER(iapd.IS_CANCELLED)) NOT IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1'))
      -- include if the detail row indicates IAP by its TERM_CODE or other fields
      AND (iapd.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(UPPER(iapd.TERM_CODE), 'IAP') > 0
           OR iap.SESSION_DATE IS NOT NULL)
    )
),
sponsor_names_per_session AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY sp.SPONSOR_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS sponsor_names
  FROM iap_subject_session s
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_sponsor sp
    ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  GROUP BY s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(isc.SUBJECT_ID, isc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_identifier,
  isc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  -- prefer HASS_ATTRIBUTE or CIP category where available
  COALESCE(cco.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, cip.CATEGORY_TITLE, cco.HGN_CODE, '') AS category,
  isc.SESSION_TITLE AS session_title,
  isc.SESSION_START_TIME AS session_start_time,
  isc.SESSION_END_TIME AS session_end_time,
  snps.sponsor_names AS sponsor_name,
  COALESCE(sisc.total_sessions_for_subject, 0) AS total_sessions_for_subject
FROM iap_sessions isc
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cco
  ON cco.SUBJECT_ID = isc.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN cip
  ON cip.PROGRAM_CODE = cco.HGN_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_iap_session_counts sisc
  ON sisc.SUBJECT_ID = isc.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN sponsor_names_per_session snps
  ON snps.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
ORDER BY isc.SUBJECT_TITLE, isc.SESSION_START_TIME

rows.question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, and the total number of courses per department.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subject_rows_drupal AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
  WHERE `DEPARTMENT_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
course_subject_rows_offered AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SECTION_ID`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `DEPARTMENT_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
course_subject_rows_cis AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `cis_course_catalog`
  WHERE `DEPARTMENT_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
all_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE FROM course_subject_rows_cis
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE FROM course_subject_rows_drupal
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE FROM course_subject_rows_offered
),
cis_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses
  FROM course_subject_rows_cis
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
),
drupal_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses
  FROM course_subject_rows_drupal
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
),
offered_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    -- prefer distinct SUBJECT_ID if present, else distinct SECTION_ID
    GREATEST(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN SUBJECT_ID END),
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SUBJECT_ID IS NULL THEN SECTION_ID END)
    ) AS total_courses
  FROM course_subject_rows_offered
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
)
SELECT
  ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ak.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM course_subject_rows_cis cs WHERE cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cs.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT ds.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM course_subject_rows_drupal ds WHERE ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ds.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT os.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM course_subject_rows_offered os WHERE os.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND os.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT cs.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM course_subject_rows_cis cs WHERE cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cs.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT ds.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM course_subject_rows_drupal ds WHERE ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ds.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT os.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM course_subject_rows_offered os WHERE os.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND os.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE LIMIT 1)
  ) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- no explicit graduate-level indicator in these tables; return NULL per instructions
  NULL AS IS_GRADUATE_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT total_courses FROM cis_counts c WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE),
    (SELECT total_courses FROM drupal_counts d WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND d.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE),
    (SELECT total_courses FROM offered_counts o WHERE o.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND o.SUBJECT_CODE = ak.SUBJECT_CODE),
    0
  ) AS TOTAL_COURSES
FROM all_keys ak
ORDER BY ak.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC, ak.SUBJECT_CODE ASC

rows.question: For each term, list the term code, the term description, whether the term is current or not, and the total number of types of CIS courses.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH cis_course_subject_by_effective_term AS (
  SELECT
    c.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    c.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
    c.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    c.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR
  FROM `cis_course_catalog` c
),
academic_terms_core AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    `TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    `IS_CURRENT_TERM` AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
    `ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY` AS ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY
  FROM `academic_terms`
)
SELECT
  atc.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  atc.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  atc.IS_CURRENT_TERM AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  COALESCE(ct.cis_course_count, 0) AS CIS_COURSE_COUNT
FROM academic_terms_core AS atc
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    term_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_ID)) AS cis_course_count
  FROM (
    -- prefer EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE when present
    SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_ID, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS term_key
    FROM cis_course_subject_by_effective_term
    WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    -- also consider ACADEMIC_YEAR if EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE not available for a row;
    -- we include ACADEMIC_YEAR but only for rows where EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE was null
    SELECT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_ID, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS term_key
    FROM cis_course_subject_by_effective_term
    WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NULL AND ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
  ) t
  WHERE COALESCE(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_ID) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY term_key
) ct
  ON ct.term_key = atc.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY atc.TERM_CODE

rows.question: What is the author, school name, material status, total record counts, and total number of types of courses for each author and school?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH numbers AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
exploded_authors AS (
  -- split authors on ';' into separate rows, keep TIP_MATERIAL_KEY to join back
  SELECT
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.`AUTHOR`, ';', numbers.n), ';', -1)) AS author,
    t.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    t.`AUTHOR` AS authors_raw
  FROM `tip_material` t
  JOIN numbers ON numbers.n <= 1 + (LENGTH(COALESCE(t.`AUTHOR`, '')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(t.`AUTHOR`, ''), ';', '')))
  WHERE t.`AUTHOR` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.`AUTHOR`) <> ''
),
tip_with_status AS (
  SELECT
    td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    td.`RECORD_COUNT`,
    td.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  FROM `tip_detail` td
),
status_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS material_status
  FROM `tip_material_status`
),
subject_offered AS (
  SELECT
    `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    `OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`,
    `COURSE_NUMBER`,
    `MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `tip_subject_offered`
),
author_school_material AS (
  SELECT
    ea.author,
    -- normalize TIP to full name for grouping/display
    CASE
      WHEN so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`) = 'TIP' THEN 'Textbook Information Provisioning'
      ELSE so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`
    END AS school_name,
    COALESCE(sl.material_status, 'UNKNOWN') AS material_status,
    COALESCE(tws.RECORD_COUNT, 0) AS record_count,
    -- create a course_type identifier to count distinct course types per author/school/status
    CONCAT(COALESCE(so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,''), '::', COALESCE(so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,''), '::', COALESCE(so.COURSE_NUMBER,'')) AS course_type_key
  FROM exploded_authors ea
  LEFT JOIN tip_with_status tws ON ea.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = tws.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN status_lookup sl ON tws.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = sl.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered so ON tws.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = so.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  -- only keep rows where author and school are present (school may be NULL due to left join)
  WHERE ea.author IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ea.author) <> ''
    AND (
      (so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`) <> '')
      OR (so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME` IS NULL AND FALSE) -- keeps intent explicit; handled by CASE below
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    author,
    school_name,
    material_status,
    SUM(record_count) AS total_record_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT course_type_key) AS distinct_course_type_count
  FROM author_school_material
  WHERE school_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(school_name) <> ''
  GROUP BY author, school_name, material_status
)
SELECT
  author,
  school_name,
  material_status,
  COALESCE(total_record_count, 0) AS total_record_count,
  COALESCE(distinct_course_type_count, 0) AS distinct_course_type_count
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY school_name ASC, author ASC

rows.question: What is the course number, subject title, material status, the total, min, and max new shelf price, the total, min, and max used shelf price, total number of schools and the total number of materials for each TIP subject and material status?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_material_status_agg AS (
  SELECT
    c.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS`, 'UNKNOWN') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    c.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    c.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`) AS MATERIAL_COUNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`) AS DISTINCT_SCHOOL_COUNT,
    -- sum/min/max only consider numeric (non-NULL) price values
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE` IS NOT NULL THEN m.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE` ELSE 0 END) AS SUM_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.`USED_SHELF_PRICE` IS NOT NULL THEN m.`USED_SHELF_PRICE` ELSE 0 END) AS SUM_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    MIN(m.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE`) AS MIN_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    MIN(m.`USED_SHELF_PRICE`) AS MIN_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    MAX(m.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE`) AS MAX_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    MAX(m.`USED_SHELF_PRICE`) AS MAX_USED_SHELF_PRICE
  FROM tip_detail td
  JOIN tip_material m
    ON td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = m.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status ms
    ON td.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered so
    ON td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = so.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog c
    ON td.`SUBJECT_ID` = c.`SUBJECT_ID`
  -- restrict to rows that originate from TIP by using the TIP tables as the base (tip_detail joined above),
  -- so no extra source filter is needed; ensure subject linkage exists by requiring a subject id
  WHERE td.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    c.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS`,
    c.`SUBJECT_CODE`,
    c.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    c.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(smsa.SUBJECT_CODE, smsa.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  smsa.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  smsa.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  smsa.MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  smsa.SUM_NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS TOTAL_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  smsa.MIN_NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS MIN_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  smsa.MAX_NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS MAX_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  smsa.SUM_USED_SHELF_PRICE AS TOTAL_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
  smsa.MIN_USED_SHELF_PRICE AS MIN_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
  smsa.MAX_USED_SHELF_PRICE AS MAX_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
  smsa.DISTINCT_SCHOOL_COUNT AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_SCHOOLS,
  smsa.MATERIAL_COUNT AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_MATERIALS
FROM subject_material_status_agg smsa
ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ASC, MATERIAL_STATUS ASC

rows.question: What is material status, the total number of materials, the total number of subjects, the total number of schools, and the most recent publication year for each material status?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH tip_rowlevel AS (
  SELECT
    tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    tm.YEAR AS PUBLICATION_YEAR
  FROM tip_detail AS tmd
  JOIN tip_material_status AS tms
    ON tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    AND tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered AS tso
    ON tmd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material AS tm
    ON tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
tip_publication_years AS (
  SELECT
    TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- normalize YEAR to integer when possible, else NULL
    CASE
      WHEN tm_year IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(tm_year) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN tm_year REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*-?[0-9]+[[:space:]]*$' THEN CAST(TRIM(tm_year) AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS PUBLICATION_YEAR_INT
  FROM (
    SELECT
      TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
      TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
      SUBJECT_ID,
      OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
      PUBLICATION_YEAR AS tm_year
    FROM tip_rowlevel
  ) _sub
)
SELECT
  TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  COUNT(*) AS MATERIAL_COUNT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS DISTINCT_SUBJECT_COUNT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS DISTINCT_SCHOOL_COUNT,
  MAX(PUBLICATION_YEAR_INT) AS LATEST_PUBLICATION_YEAR
FROM tip_publication_years
WHERE TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
ORDER BY TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS

  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cis
    ON cis.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID
    AND cis.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
),
academic_term_reference AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY AS ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.TERM_START_DATE AS TERM_START_DATE,

  FROM academic_terms at
)
SELECT
  atr.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  atr.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  atr.IS_CURRENT_TERM AS is_current,
  COALESCE(tso_counts.total_types_of_TIP_subjects_offered, 0) AS total_types_of_TIP_subjects_offered,
  COALESCE(tm_counts.materials_needed_count, 0) AS materials_needed_count,
  tso_counts.min_enrolled_students AS min_enrolled_students,
  tso_counts.max_enrolled_students AS max_enrolled_students,
  COALESCE(tso_counts.total_schools_offering_subjects, 0) AS total_schools_offering_subjects,
  COALESCE(tco.total_records, 0) AS total_records

    tso.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,

rows.question: List all buildings with their names, building numbers, building height, street address, city, state, HR department name, assignable square footage, total and average square footage, ordered in descending order of assignable, total, and average square footage.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_hr_departments AS (
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS HR_ORG_UNIT_ID,
  fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
  ON fo.D_CODE = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
    OR fo.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
    OR fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME
),
buildings_street_addresses AS (
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- assemble ADDRESS_LINE from fac_building_address stored street components as they appear in that table
  CONCAT(
    NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
    CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER <> '' AND fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX <> '' THEN CONCAT(fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN (fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER <> '') AND (fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL <> '') THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL) WHEN (fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL <> '') THEN fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN (fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME <> '') AND ( (fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER <> '') OR (fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL <> '') ) THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_NAME) WHEN (fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME <> '') THEN fba.STREET_NAME ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN fba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL) ELSE '' END
  ) AS ADDRESS_LINE,
  fba.CITY AS CITY,
  fba.STATE AS STATE,
  fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE AS ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
  fba.BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY AS ADDRESS_ID
FROM buildings b
JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
buildings_core_measures AS (
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY               AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER            AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME              AS BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE        AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM buildings b
)
SELECT
  bcm.BUILDING_NAME AS name,
  bcm.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  NULL AS building_height_ft,
  sa.ADDRESS_LINE AS street_address,
  sa.CITY AS city,
  sa.STATE AS state,
  hdr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
  bcm.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS `assignable_sqft:float`,
  bcm.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS `total_sqft:float`,
  CASE
    WHEN bcm.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN sa.addr_count IS NULL OR sa.addr_count = 0 THEN bcm.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
    ELSE bcm.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE / GREATEST(sa.addr_count,1)
  END AS `average_sqft:float`
FROM buildings_core_measures AS bcm
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    -- pick the first street address components per building (views already restricted to ADDRESS_PURPOSE='STREET')
    MIN(ADDRESS_LINE) AS ADDRESS_LINE,
    MIN(CITY) AS CITY,
    MIN(STATE) AS STATE,
    COUNT(*) AS addr_count
  FROM buildings_street_addresses
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) AS sa ON sa.BUILDING_KEY = bcm.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM building_hr_departments
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) AS hdr ON hdr.BUILDING_KEY = bcm.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY
  bcm.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC,
  bcm.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC,
  `average_sqft:float` DESC

rows.question: For the 2023 Fall term, what are the unique term descriptions, subject titles along with their prerequisites, total number of types of subjects per term code, instructor of this course, and the number of types of courses ever taught by the instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH combined_offered AS (
  -- Union relevant source tables that have the needed columns.
  -- Keep key columns SECTION_ID (when present) and SUBJECT_CODE to deduplicate properly.
  SELECT
    co.`TERM_CODE`,
    co.`SUBJECT_CODE`,
    co.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    co.`PREREQUISITES`,
    co.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
    co.`SECTION_ID`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` co
  WHERE co.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ci.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `TERM_CODE`, -- cis_course_catalog doesn't have TERM_CODE column name; use ACADEMIC_YEAR only if TERM_CODE absent.
    ci.`SUBJECT_CODE`,
    ci.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    ci.`PREREQUISITES`,
    ci.`FALL_INSTRUCTORS` AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
    NULL AS `SECTION_ID`
  FROM `cis_course_catalog` ci
  WHERE ci.`SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    dr.`SO_TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    dr.`SUBJECT_CODE`,
    dr.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    dr.`PREREQUISITES`,
    dr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
    dr.`SECTION_ID`
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog` dr
  WHERE dr.`SO_TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),

-- Deduplicate courses in the requested term by SUBJECT_CODE and SECTION_ID (or SUBJECT_CODE if SECTION_ID is null)
dedup_term_courses AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    PREREQUISITES,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    COALESCE(SECTION_ID, '') AS SECTION_ID,
    -- keep one row per SUBJECT_CODE + SECTION_ID
    MIN(CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBJECT_TITLE,''), '||', COALESCE(PREREQUISITES,''), '||', COALESCE(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,''))) AS _keep_marker
  FROM combined_offered
  WHERE TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE, COALESCE(SECTION_ID, '')
),

-- Count distinct SUBJECT_CODE in the 2023FA term
num_subject_types_in_term AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_IN_TERM
  FROM combined_offered
  WHERE TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
),

-- For each instructor, count distinct SUBJECT_CODE they have ever taught (across all terms in combined sources)
instructor_subject_counts AS (
  SELECT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_TAUGHT_BY_INSTRUCTOR_EVER
  FROM combined_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
)

SELECT
  at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  '2023FA' AS TERM_CODE,
  d.SUBJECT_CODE,
  d.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  d.PREREQUISITES,
  d.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  COALESCE(n.NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_IN_TERM, 0) AS NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_IN_TERM,
  COALESCE(isc.NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_TAUGHT_BY_INSTRUCTOR_EVER, 0) AS NUM_SUBJECT_TYPES_TAUGHT_BY_INSTRUCTOR_EVER
FROM dedup_term_courses d
LEFT JOIN num_subject_types_in_term n ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN instructor_subject_counts isc
  ON d.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME = isc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
LEFT JOIN `academic_terms` at
  ON at.`TERM_CODE` = '2023FA'
-- Only include rows for the 2023 Fall term (dedup_term_courses already filtered), ensure SUBJECT_CODE present
WHERE d.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  TERM_CODE ASC,
  d.SUBJECT_CODE ASC

  fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR_NUMBER,

  fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OCCUPYING_DEPARTMENT_NAME,

    ELSE NULL
  END AS PCT_OF_FLOOR_AREA,
  -- percent of room area over building area (use ASSIGNABLE_AREA if present, else EXT_GROSS_AREA)
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) > 0

    ELSE NULL
  END AS PCT_OF_BUILDING_AREA
FROM fac_rooms fr

LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
  ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_organization fo
  ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY

  AND COALESCE(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, ff.EXT_GROSS_AREA) > 0

  AND COALESCE(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) > 0
