rows.question: What are the building names, department names, organizations, their highest and lowest floor number, along with the total number of rooms per each building key?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME
  FROM `buildings` AS b
),
-- derive department and organization names from room-level tables that reference BUILDING_KEY
departments_and_orgs_by_building AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    -- fac_rooms.DEPT_CODE likely holds a department code; use hr_org_unit / sis_department join only if available.
    -- There is no direct reliable join in schema from DEPT_CODE to sis_department key names,
    -- so return the department code as the department name where no better mapping exists.
    NULLIF(fr.DEPT_CODE, '') AS dept_name,
    NULLIF(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') AS org_name
  FROM `fac_rooms` fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
rooms_by_building AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.ROOM AS room_id,
    -- FLOOR fields are varchar in schema; attempt numeric cast for min/max
    CASE WHEN fr.FLOOR RLIKE '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(fr.FLOOR AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS floor_number
  FROM `fac_rooms` fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- concatenated distinct department names (or codes) or NULL if none
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAMES AS DEPARTMENT_NAMES,
  -- concatenated distinct organization names or NULL if none
  d.ORGANIZATION_NAMES AS ORGANIZATION_NAMES,
  -- highest and lowest floor numbers computed from explicit FLOOR fields; NULL if none numeric
  r.HIGHEST_FLOOR_NUMBER AS HIGHEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
  r.LOWEST_FLOOR_NUMBER AS LOWEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
  -- total count of rooms linked to the BUILDING_KEY (0 if none)
  COALESCE(r.TOTAL_ROOMS, 0) AS TOTAL_ROOMS
FROM buildings_core b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dept_name ORDER BY dept_name SEPARATOR ', '), '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAMES,
    NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT org_name ORDER BY org_name SEPARATOR ', '), '') AS ORGANIZATION_NAMES
  FROM departments_and_orgs_by_building
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) d ON d.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    MAX(floor_number) AS HIGHEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
    MIN(floor_number) AS LOWEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT room_id) AS TOTAL_ROOMS
  FROM rooms_by_building
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: Provide the complete information for students with the first name Kevin, including their full names, email addresses, department names, department phone numbers, school names, and the total student count per department and school. If a student is associated with more than one department, list a separate row for each department.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH person_directory_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    `MIT_ID`,
    -- prefer drupal FULL_NAME when present, else will build later in main select
    `FULL_NAME`,
    `FIRST_NAME`,
    `MIDDLE_NAME`,
    `LAST_NAME`,
    `EMAIL_ADDRESS`
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
  WHERE `FIRST_NAME` = 'Kevin'
),
-- all department associations for students from other tables keyed by MIT_ID where possible
-- use mit_student_directory.DEPARTMENT as department code (DEPARTMENT is present in mit_student_directory)
student_department_assoc AS (
  SELECT
    pdn.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(pdn.FULL_NAME, NULL) AS DRUPAL_FULL_NAME,
    pdn.FIRST_NAME,
    pdn.MIDDLE_NAME,
    pdn.LAST_NAME,
    pdn.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM person_directory_normalized pdn
  LEFT JOIN `mit_student_directory` msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = pdn.FULL_NAME
    OR (msd.FIRST_NAME = pdn.FIRST_NAME AND msd.LAST_NAME = pdn.LAST_NAME)
    -- above join attempts to match by FULL_NAME first, then by first+last as best-effort
),
-- department-level distinct student counts (by MIT_ID) using mit_student_directory linkage where possible
dept_student_counts AS (
  SELECT
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pd.MIT_ID) AS DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT
  FROM `mit_student_directory` msd
  JOIN person_directory_normalized pd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = pd.FULL_NAME
    OR (msd.FIRST_NAME = pd.FIRST_NAME AND msd.LAST_NAME = pd.LAST_NAME)
  WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT IS NOT NULL AND msd.DEPARTMENT <> ''
  GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT
),
-- school-level distinct student counts (by MIT_ID) via sis_department -> school_code
school_student_counts AS (
  SELECT
    sd.SCHOOL_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pd.MIT_ID) AS SCHOOL_STUDENT_COUNT
  FROM `mit_student_directory` msd
  LEFT JOIN `sis_department` sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
  JOIN person_directory_normalized pd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = pd.FULL_NAME
    OR (msd.FIRST_NAME = pd.FIRST_NAME AND msd.LAST_NAME = pd.LAST_NAME)
  WHERE sd.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND sd.SCHOOL_CODE <> ''
  GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE
)
SELECT
  -- STUDENT_FULL_NAME: prefer drupal FULL_NAME, else construct from parts (include middle if present)
  COALESCE(
    pd.FULL_NAME,
    CONCAT(
      pd.FIRST_NAME,
      CASE WHEN pd.MIDDLE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pd.MIDDLE_NAME) <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', pd.MIDDLE_NAME) ELSE '' END,
      ' ',
      pd.LAST_NAME
    )
  ) AS STUDENT_FULL_NAME,
  pd.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
  pd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COALESCE(dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT, 0) AS DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT,
  COALESCE(school_counts.SCHOOL_STUDENT_COUNT, 0) AS SCHOOL_STUDENT_COUNT
FROM person_directory_normalized pd
-- get department association per student (may be NULL)
LEFT JOIN `mit_student_directory` msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = pd.FULL_NAME
  OR (msd.FIRST_NAME = pd.FIRST_NAME AND msd.LAST_NAME = pd.LAST_NAME)
LEFT JOIN `sis_department` sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN dept_student_counts dept_counts
  ON dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN school_student_counts school_counts
  ON school_counts.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE
-- ensure one row per distinct department association per student:
GROUP BY
  pd.MIT_ID,
  STUDENT_FULL_NAME,
  pd.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_CODE,
  dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT,
  school_counts.SCHOOL_STUDENT_COUNT,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE

rows.question: What are the unique titles of subjects offered in the fall term along with their instructor names, instructor emails, and the total number of types of subjects per instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH catalog_fall_instructor_names AS (
  SELECT
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `SUBJECT_CODE`,
    `FALL_INSTRUCTORS`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(`FALL_INSTRUCTORS`) <> ''
),
employee_directory_persons AS (
  SELECT
    `MIT_ID`,
    `FIRST_NAME`,
    `LAST_NAME`,
    `FULL_NAME`,
    `EMAIL_ADDRESS`
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
),
-- distinct subject-instructor-term rows for fall terms
fall_subject_instructor_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cn.SUBJECT_ID,
    cn.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cn.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    cn.FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    cn.TERM_CODE
  FROM catalog_fall_instructor_names cn
  WHERE RIGHT(cn.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'FA'
),
-- count distinct subject identifiers (prefer SUBJECT_ID, fallback SUBJECT_CODE) per instructor within fall terms
types_per_instructor AS (
  SELECT
    INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBJECT_ID, ''), SUBJECT_CODE)) AS SUBJECT_TYPE_COUNT_PER_INSTRUCTOR
  FROM fall_subject_instructor_pairs
  GROUP BY INSTRUCTOR_NAME
),
-- prepare employee email lookup (one row per name) using FULL_NAME and first+last combination
instructor_emails AS (
  SELECT
    FULL_NAME,
    FIRST_NAME,
    LAST_NAME,
    MIN(EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM employee_directory_persons
  GROUP BY FULL_NAME, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME
)
SELECT
  f.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  f.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  ie.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS INSTRUCTOR_EMAIL,
  t.SUBJECT_TYPE_COUNT_PER_INSTRUCTOR AS SUBJECT_TYPE_COUNT_PER_INSTRUCTOR
FROM fall_subject_instructor_pairs f
LEFT JOIN types_per_instructor t
  ON t.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = f.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
LEFT JOIN instructor_emails ie
  ON ie.FULL_NAME = f.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
     OR CONCAT(ie.FIRST_NAME, ' ', ie.LAST_NAME) = f.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  f.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC,
  f.INSTRUCTOR_NAME ASC

rows.question: List the building names, names of HR departments occupying them, the total gross square footage, the total and average assignable square footage, and the built year per building key.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_hr_occupancy_rows AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    d.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
  JOIN buildings b
    ON d.OFFICE_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  WHERE d.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
    AND d.OFFICE_LOCATION <> ''
    AND d.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
    AND d.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE <> ''
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COALESCE(hr.hr_department_name, '') AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE,
  COALESCE(SUM(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE), 0) AS TOTAL_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  COALESCE(SUM(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE), 0) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  COALESCE(AVG(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE), 0) AS AVG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(f.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS BUILD_YEAR
FROM buildings b
LEFT JOIN fclt_building f
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = f.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE ORDER BY HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE SEPARATOR ', ') AS hr_department_name
  FROM building_hr_occupancy_rows
  WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) hr ON hr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  -- only include rows where DATE_BUILT is a valid MM/DD/YYYY string in fclt_building
  AND f.DATE_BUILT IS NOT NULL
  AND f.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4}$'
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, hr.hr_department_name, f.DATE_BUILT
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME ASC

rows.question: Retrieve the titles of subjects offered in the summer term along with their descriptions, responsible faculty names, email address, building name, room name, floor level, building street address, and the total number of types of courses per departmnet.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offered_core AS (
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    so.MEET_PLACE,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    so.SECTION_ID
  FROM subject_offered so
),
faculty_directory_emails AS (
  SELECT
    d.`MIT_ID`,
    d.`FULL_NAME`,
    d.`EMAIL_ADDRESS`
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
),
department_section_course_type_flags AS (
  SELECT
    c.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.`IS_LECTURE_SECTION` IS NOT NULL AND c.`IS_LECTURE_SECTION` <> '' THEN 'LECTURE' END) AS IS_LECTURE_SECTION_DISTINCT_COUNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.`IS_LAB_SECTION` IS NOT NULL AND c.`IS_LAB_SECTION` <> '' THEN 'LAB' END) AS IS_LAB_SECTION_DISTINCT_COUNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.`IS_RECITATION_SECTION` IS NOT NULL AND c.`IS_RECITATION_SECTION` <> '' THEN 'RECITATION' END) AS IS_RECITATION_SECTION_DISTINCT_COUNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.`IS_DESIGN_SECTION` IS NOT NULL AND c.`IS_DESIGN_SECTION` <> '' THEN 'DESIGN' END) AS IS_DESIGN_SECTION_DISTINCT_COUNT
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  GROUP BY c.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`
),
course_section_offers_summer_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    c.MEET_PLACE,
    c.IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
    c.IS_LAB_SECTION,
    c.IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
    c.IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.SECTION_ID
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
  WHERE
    c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y'
    OR c.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
    OR c.TERM_CODE LIKE 'S%'
    OR c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
)
SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION AS subject_description,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS responsible_faculty_name,
  f.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COALESCE(fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME, fr.ROOM, c.MEET_PLACE) AS room_name,
  fr.FLOOR AS floor_level,
  fba.STREET_NAME AS building_street_address,
  (
    (CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.IS_LECTURE_SECTION_DISTINCT_COUNT,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.IS_LAB_SECTION_DISTINCT_COUNT,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.IS_RECITATION_SECTION_DISTINCT_COUNT,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.IS_DESIGN_SECTION_DISTINCT_COUNT,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS total_course_types_per_department
FROM course_section_offers_summer_cohort c
LEFT JOIN faculty_directory_emails f
  ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = f.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
  ON c.MEET_PLACE = fr.ROOM       -- fac_rooms has column `ROOM` for room identifier; use that to join meet place
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN department_section_course_type_flags d
  ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'

rows.question: For each term code, list the term description, attribute desciption, department name, school name, and the number of subjects in the area of humanities, arts and social sciences.

WITH cis_course_catalog_subjects AS (

    c.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,

    c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE
  FROM `cis_course_catalog` c
  WHERE c.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND c.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
academic_terms_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    `academic_terms`.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    `academic_terms`.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    `academic_terms`.`TERM_START_DATE` AS TERM_START_DATE,
    `academic_terms`.`TERM_END_DATE` AS TERM_END_DATE,
    `academic_terms`.`ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY` AS ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY
  FROM `academic_terms`
),
cis_hass_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    `cis_hass_attribute`.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    `cis_hass_attribute`.`DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN` AS DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN,
    `cis_hass_attribute`.`CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP` AS CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP
  FROM `cis_hass_attribute`
  WHERE `cis_hass_attribute`.`CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP` = 'H'
)
SELECT
  atc.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  atc.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  cha.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_SUBJECTS_H
FROM academic_terms_canonical atc
JOIN cis_course_catalog_subjects ccc
  ON ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = atc.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN cis_hass_attributes cha
  ON cha.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
-- ensure only subjects whose HASS attribute maps to CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP='H' are counted:
WHERE cha.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  atc.TERM_CODE,
  atc.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  cha.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN,
  ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY atc.TERM_CODE ASC

rows.question: List building names, their height, street address, city, state, postal code, their gross and assignable square footage, the smallest and largest floor level and the total area of all rooms for each building key.

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT, NULL) AS BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  addr.STREET_NAME AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  addr.CITY,
  addr.STATE,
  addr.POSTAL_CODE,
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,

  r.MAX_FLOOR_LEVEL,
  r.TOTAL_ROOM_AREA
FROM buildings b

  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(FLOOR) AS MIN_FLOOR_LEVEL,
    MAX(FLOOR) AS MAX_FLOOR_LEVEL,

    SUM(AREA) AS TOTAL_ROOM_AREA

  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY

    POSTAL_CODE

  WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
) addr
  ON addr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: What is the category title, version, department name, school name, total number of courses for each course level, and the total number of degree-granting courses for each CIP category code?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  cpv.CATEGORY_TITLE AS category_title,
  cpv.CATEGORY_CODE AS category_code,
  cpv.VERSION AS version,
  scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level_undergraduate_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level_graduate_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS level_certificate_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM (
  -- pick latest VERSION per PROGRAM_CODE
  SELECT c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.VERSION
  FROM cip AS c
  JOIN (
    SELECT PROGRAM_CODE, MAX(VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION
    FROM cip
    GROUP BY PROGRAM_CODE
  ) lv
    ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = lv.PROGRAM_CODE
   AND c.VERSION = lv.MAX_VERSION
) AS cpv
JOIN sis_course_description AS scd
  ON scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = cpv.PROGRAM_CODE
-- no extra heavy joins; group by the reporting attributes
GROUP BY
  cpv.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  cpv.CATEGORY_CODE,
  cpv.VERSION,
  scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  scd.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY cpv.CATEGORY_CODE, cpv.VERSION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME

rows.question: What is the total number of library materials, the minimum and maximum publication years, and the total number of materials status for each course name?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_materials AS (
  SELECT
    lci.COURSE_NAME AS COURSE_NAME,
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    lrc.CATALOG_YEAR,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
  FROM library_course_instructor lci
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    COURSE_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_materials_count,
    MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(CATALOG_YEAR), '')) AS min_pub_year_text,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(CATALOG_YEAR), '')) AS max_pub_year_text
  FROM course_materials
  GROUP BY COURSE_NAME
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    cm.COURSE_NAME,
    COALESCE(cm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'NULL') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS status_count
  FROM course_materials cm
  GROUP BY cm.COURSE_NAME, COALESCE(cm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'NULL')
)
SELECT
  a.COURSE_NAME AS COURSE_NAME,
  a.total_materials_count AS total_materials_count,
  -- convert year text to integer where possible; return NULL if not a valid integer
  CASE
    WHEN a.min_pub_year_text REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(a.min_pub_year_text AS SIGNED)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS min_publication_year,
  CASE
    WHEN a.max_pub_year_text REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(a.max_pub_year_text AS SIGNED)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS max_publication_year,
  -- materials_status_counts as JSON object mapping status -> count
  (
    SELECT CONCAT('{', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('"', REPLACE(MATERIAL_STATUS, '"', '\"'), '":', status_count) ORDER BY MATERIAL_STATUS SEPARATOR ','), '}')
    FROM status_counts sc
    WHERE sc.COURSE_NAME = a.COURSE_NAME
  ) AS materials_status_counts
FROM aggregated a
ORDER BY a.COURSE_NAME ASC

rows.question: What is the total number of library reserve materials, the minimum and maximum publication years, and the total number of enrolled students for each course instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_sections_with_responsible_instructor AS (
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`) <> ''
    AND `SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
library_reserve_items_by_section AS (
  SELECT
    m.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    m.`TERM_CODE`,
    m.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    m.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
    c.`CATALOG_YEAR`,
    -- indicate whether a catalog row exists for the mapping
    (c.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` IS NOT NULL) AS has_mapping,
    -- treat LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY as the section-like key for joins
    m.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` AS SECTION_ID
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` m
  LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` c
    ON m.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = c.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
),
instructor_enrollment_by_section AS (
  SELECT
    `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` AS SECTION_ID,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
    COALESCE(`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, 0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENT_COUNT
  FROM `library_subject_offered`
  WHERE `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(csr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`, csr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`) AS instructor_identifier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lr.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`) AS total_reserve_materials,
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN lr.`CATALOG_YEAR` REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,4}$' THEN CAST(lr.`CATALOG_YEAR` AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN lr.`CATALOG_YEAR` REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,4}$' THEN CAST(lr.`CATALOG_YEAR` AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS max_publication_year,
  COALESCE(SUM(ieb.`ENROLLED_STUDENT_COUNT`), 0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM course_sections_with_responsible_instructor csr
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_items_by_section lr
  ON lr.`SECTION_ID` = csr.`SECTION_ID`
LEFT JOIN instructor_enrollment_by_section ieb
  ON ieb.`SECTION_ID` = lr.`SECTION_ID`
    AND (
      (csr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND ieb.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` = csr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`)
      OR (csr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND ieb.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` = csr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`)
    )
GROUP BY COALESCE(csr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`, csr.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`)
HAVING total_reserve_materials > 0 OR total_enrolled_students > 0
ORDER BY instructor_identifier

rows.question: What is the material status, term description, total number of courses and materials, occurences in departments and school, and the total number of instructors for each library material status code and term code?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE` AS MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS MATERIAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,
  at.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, at_all.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(cc.total_courses,0) AS TOTAL_COURSES,
  COALESCE(mc.total_materials,0) AS TOTAL_MATERIALS,
  COALESCE(dc.dept_occurrences,0) AS TOTAL_DEPARTMENT_OCCURRENCES,
  COALESCE(sc.school_occurrences,0) AS TOTAL_SCHOOL_OCCURRENCES,
  COALESCE(ic.total_instructors,0) AS TOTAL_INSTRUCTORS
FROM `library_material_status` lms
-- only consider non-null status codes
INNER JOIN (
  -- distinct term codes that appear in reserve detail or subject offered or academic terms
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE FROM `library_subject_offered` WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE FROM `academic_terms` WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
) terms ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN `academic_terms` at
  ON at.`TERM_CODE` = terms.`TERM_CODE`
LEFT JOIN `academic_terms_all` at_all
  ON at_all.`TERM_CODE` = terms.`TERM_CODE`
-- bring the term_code value to top level (use terms.TERM_CODE)
-- counts: distinct courses per (status, term)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`) AS total_courses
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  WHERE lrmd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`, lrmd.`TERM_CODE`
) cc
  ON cc.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  AND cc.`TERM_CODE` = terms.`TERM_CODE`
-- total distinct materials per (status, term)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`) AS total_materials
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  WHERE lrmd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`, lrmd.`TERM_CODE`
) mc
  ON mc.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  AND mc.`TERM_CODE` = terms.`TERM_CODE`
-- department-level occurrences: distinct combinations of department, material, course, term
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(COALESCE(lso.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE`,''),'||',COALESCE(lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,''),'||',COALESCE(lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,''),'||',COALESCE(lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,''))) AS dept_occurrences
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
    ON lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  WHERE lrmd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`, lrmd.`TERM_CODE`
) dc
  ON dc.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  AND dc.`TERM_CODE` = terms.`TERM_CODE`
-- school-level occurrences: prefer OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, fallback to mapping via department->school if available;
-- since no separate department->school mapping table reliably exists in schema, use OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME when present,
-- otherwise fall back to department-level count (as requested)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(COALESCE(lso.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`, lso.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`, lso.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, ''),'||',COALESCE(lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,''),'||',COALESCE(lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,''),'||',COALESCE(lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,''))) AS school_occurrences
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
    ON lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  WHERE lrmd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`, lrmd.`TERM_CODE`
) sc
  ON sc.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  AND sc.`TERM_CODE` = terms.`TERM_CODE`
-- instructors: count distinct instructor identifiers/names associated with the courses/materials in that term
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(lso.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,''), NULLIF(lso.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,''), NULLIF(lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME`,''))) AS total_instructors
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
    ON lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `library_course_instructor` lci
    ON (lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND (
         lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` = lso.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` OR
         lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` = lso.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
       ))
  WHERE lrmd.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`, lrmd.`TERM_CODE`
) ic
  ON ic.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  AND ic.`TERM_CODE` = terms.`TERM_CODE`
WHERE lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  AND terms.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  -- exclude combinations with no courses and no materials (require >0)
  AND (
    COALESCE(cc.total_courses,0) > 0
    OR COALESCE(mc.total_materials,0) > 0
  )
ORDER BY lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE` ASC, terms.`TERM_CODE` ASC

rows.question: For building 36, list all space units, their floor and building name, building street address, their space usage, and the number of organizations and space units on the same building and floor.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_36 AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME
  FROM buildings b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'
),
street_address AS (
  -- one street address per building (ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET')
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY,
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NAME, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.CITY, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STATE, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.POSTAL_CODE, '')
    ) AS ADDRESS
  FROM fac_building_address fba
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
building_floor_counts AS (
  -- counts of distinct organizations and space units per building_number+floor
  SELECT
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(zrl.BUILDING_ROOM, ' ', 1) AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    zrl.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zrl.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS org_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zrl.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS unit_count
  FROM zpm_rooms_load zrl
  GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(zrl.BUILDING_ROOM, ' ', 1), zrl.FLOOR
)
SELECT
  su2.SPACE_UNIT AS SPACE_UNIT,
  su2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
  zrl.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  sa.ADDRESS AS ADDRESS,
  su.SPACE_USAGE AS SPACE_USAGE,
  COALESCE(bfc.org_count, 0) AS organizations_on_same_building_and_floor,
  COALESCE(bfc.unit_count, 0) AS space_units_on_same_building_and_floor
FROM zpm_rooms_load zrl
JOIN space_unit2 su2
  ON zrl.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
LEFT JOIN space_usage su
  ON zrl.SPACE_USAGE = su.SPACE_USAGE
JOIN building_36 b
  -- join by building number extracted from BUILDING_ROOM
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = SUBSTRING_INDEX(zrl.BUILDING_ROOM, ' ', 1)
LEFT JOIN street_address sa
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sa.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_floor_counts bfc
  ON bfc.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  AND bfc.FLOOR = zrl.FLOOR
ORDER BY su2.SPACE_UNIT

rows.question: For each distinct mailing list containing more than 1000 people and with a name starting with A (case insensitive), provide its name, whether it is a mailing list, whether it is a moira group, whether it is a NFS group, the owner of the mailing list, and the number of people in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  -- treat IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST as the "is_mailing_list" flag
  CASE WHEN ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST IN ('Y','1','y','true','T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mailing_list,
  CASE WHEN ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP IN ('Y','1','y','true','T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_moira_group,
  CASE WHEN ml.IS_NFS_GROUP IN ('Y','1','y','true','T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_nfs_group,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
FROM moira_list ml
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner mlo
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'a%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP,
  mlo.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 1000

rows.question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_mailing_list_metadata_with_owners AS (
  SELECT
    ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`        AS list_name,
    ml.`IS_PUBLIC`              AS is_public,
    ml.`IS_HIDDEN`              AS is_hidden,
    mlo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`  AS owner_id,
    mlo.`OWNER`                 AS owner,
    ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`         AS list_id
  FROM `moira_list` ml
  LEFT JOIN `moira_list_owner` mlo
    ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mlo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`
),
list_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS list_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`) AS member_count
  FROM `moira_list_detail`
  GROUP BY `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(member_count) AS max_count,
    MIN(member_count) AS min_count
  FROM list_member_counts
)
SELECT
  m.list_name        AS list_name,
  m.owner            AS owner,
  m.is_public        AS is_public,
  m.is_hidden        AS is_hidden,
  COALESCE(l.member_count, 0) AS member_count
FROM moira_mailing_list_metadata_with_owners m
LEFT JOIN list_member_counts l
  ON m.list_id = l.list_id
CROSS JOIN extremes e
WHERE (COALESCE(l.member_count,0) = e.max_count)
   OR (COALESCE(l.member_count,0) = e.min_count)
ORDER BY member_count DESC, m.list_name, m.owner

rows.question: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH faculty_section_assignments AS (
  SELECT
    ccso.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    NULLIF(ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, '') AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    NULLIF(ccso.TERM_CODE, '') AS TERM_CODE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
  WHERE ccso.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID <> ''
    AND ccso.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND ccso.TERM_CODE <> ''
),
academic_terms_summarized AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    CAST(NULLIF(at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, '') AS SIGNED) AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR_NUM,
    (at.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU') AS IS_SUMMER_TERM
  FROM academic_terms at
  WHERE at.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
faculty_summer_after_2001 AS (
  -- distinct faculty MIT_IDs who taught in any summer term whose financial aid year > 2001
  SELECT DISTINCT fsa.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID
  FROM faculty_section_assignments fsa
  JOIN academic_terms_summarized ats
    ON fsa.TERM_CODE = ats.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ats.IS_SUMMER_TERM = 1
    AND ats.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR_NUM IS NOT NULL
    AND ats.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR_NUM > 2001
    AND fsa.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
list_members_normalized AS (
  -- normalize member identifier: prefer explicit MIT id if present, otherwise member string
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) AS MEMBER_ID
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS MAILING_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lmn.MEMBER_ID) AS TOTAL_PEOPLE_IN_LIST,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fsm.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN lmn.MEMBER_ID END) AS FACULTY_WHO_TAUGHT_SUMMER_AFTER_2001
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN list_members_normalized lmn
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lmn.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN faculty_summer_after_2001 fsm
  ON lmn.MEMBER_ID = fsm.MIT_ID
WHERE LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'c%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: Regarding the mailing list about duo users, provide the number of students in this list, and the number of departments and schools associated with these students.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sis_person_primary_affiliations AS (
  SELECT
    -- Use MIT ID from student directory as canonical person identifier when available
    mit_student_directory.FULL_NAME AS PERSON_ID,
    -- Flag person as student when STUDENT_YEAR is non-null/non-empty
    (mit_student_directory.STUDENT_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND mit_student_directory.STUDENT_YEAR <> '') AS IS_STUDENT_FLAG,
    -- student's primary department code from the student directory
    NULLIF(TRIM(mit_student_directory.DEPARTMENT), '') AS PRIMARY_DEPARTMENT_ID,
    -- join to sis_department to get the associated school code for that department
    sis_department.SCHOOL_CODE AS PRIMARY_SCHOOL_ID
  FROM mit_student_directory
  LEFT JOIN sis_department
    ON NULLIF(TRIM(mit_student_directory.DEPARTMENT), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(sis_department.DEPARTMENT_CODE), '')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS student_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(spa.PRIMARY_DEPARTMENT_ID, '')) AS department_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(spa.PRIMARY_SCHOOL_ID, '')) AS school_count
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN sis_person_primary_affiliations spa
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = spa.PERSON_ID
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'candle-duo-users'
  -- only include members that match a SIS student record (spa.IS_STUDENT_FLAG = TRUE)
  AND spa.IS_STUDENT_FLAG = TRUE

rows.question: For faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023 fall term, list the name of mailing lists with ten members that they subscribe to, the number of faculty in these lists, and the number of courses associated with those faculty.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_sections_with_responsible_faculty AS (
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
  FROM `subject_offered`
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` = '2023FA'
    AND `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
faculty_cohort AS (
  -- faculty who are responsible for at least one course in 2023 fall
  SELECT DISTINCT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID
  FROM course_sections_with_responsible_faculty
),
moira_lists_with_10_members AS (
  -- moira lists that have exactly 10 distinct MIT_ID members
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS total_members
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  WHERE mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) = 10
),
faculty_moira_memberships AS (
  -- faculty membership records for our cohort on lists that have exactly 10 members
  SELECT DISTINCT
    f.MIT_ID,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM faculty_cohort f
  JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = f.MIT_ID
  JOIN moira_lists_with_10_members ml10
    ON ml10.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
faculty_list_counts AS (
  -- for each list, count how many distinct faculty (from cohort) are members
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fmm.MIT_ID) AS faculty_subscriber_count
  FROM faculty_moira_memberships fmm
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fmm.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
courses_by_faculty AS (
  -- number of distinct sections in 2023FA for each faculty in the cohort
  SELECT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SECTION_ID) AS associated_course_count
  FROM course_sections_with_responsible_faculty
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
)
SELECT
  flc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  flc.faculty_subscriber_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(cbf.associated_course_count), 0) AS associated_course_count
FROM faculty_list_counts flc
-- join to get each faculty member on the list so we can sum their course counts
JOIN faculty_moira_memberships fmm
  ON fmm.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = flc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN courses_by_faculty cbf
  ON cbf.MIT_ID = fmm.MIT_ID
GROUP BY
  flc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  flc.faculty_subscriber_count,
  flc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
ORDER BY
  flc.faculty_subscriber_count DESC,
  associated_course_count DESC,
  mailing_list_name ASC

rows.question: For each course instructor in the 'keeper-zephyr' mailing list, provide the name of mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest and latest publication years, and total number of enrolled students.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH employees_canonical_names AS (
SELECT
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`MIT_ID` AS `MIT_ID`,
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`FULL_NAME` AS `FULL_NAME`,
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`FIRST_NAME` AS `FIRST_NAME`,
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`LAST_NAME` AS `LAST_NAME`
FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
),
course_sections_responsible_faculty AS (
SELECT
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,

  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_TIME` AS MEET_TIME,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`MEET_PLACE` AS MEET_PLACE,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR
FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
)
SELECT
  ml_all.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list,
  ecn.FULL_NAME AS instructor_name,
  MIN(pub.PUBLICATION_YEAR) AS earliest_publication_year,
  MAX(pub.PUBLICATION_YEAR) AS latest_publication_year,
  COALESCE(enroll.total_enrolled_students,0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM moira_list ml_keeper
JOIN moira_list_detail mld_keeper
  ON mld_keeper.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml_keeper.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    AND ml_keeper.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
-- map keeper-zephyr members to canonical employee rows
JOIN employees_canonical_names ecn
  ON ecn.MIT_ID = mld_keeper.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
-- for each such instructor, find all mailing lists they subscribe to
JOIN moira_list_detail mld_all
  ON mld_all.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = ecn.MIT_ID
JOIN moira_list ml_all
  ON ml_all.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld_all.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
-- aggregate publications per instructor if a publications table exists (left join placeholder)
LEFT JOIN (
  -- If a publications table with PERSON_MIT_ID and PUBLICATION_YEAR exists, replace this select with actual table
  -- This subquery is intentionally empty because no publications base table was provided; it yields no rows.
  SELECT NULL AS MIT_ID, NULL AS PUBLICATION_YEAR
  WHERE 0
) pub_placeholder ON pub_placeholder.MIT_ID = ecn.MIT_ID
-- aggregate enrollments per instructor from course_sections_responsible_faculty joined to subject_offered_summary (if available)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    csr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM course_sections_responsible_faculty csr
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
    ON sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = csr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
       AND sos.TERM_CODE = csr.TERM_CODE
  GROUP BY csr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
) enroll ON enroll.MIT_ID = ecn.MIT_ID
-- publications aggregation (no base publication table provided; attempting to read from tip_material/tip_detail is not appropriate)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    ecn2.MIT_ID,
    MIN(pub.PUBLICATION_YEAR) AS PUBLICATION_YEAR -- placeholder
  FROM employees_canonical_names ecn2
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT NULL AS MIT_ID, NULL AS PUBLICATION_YEAR WHERE 0) pub ON pub.MIT_ID = ecn2.MIT_ID
  GROUP BY ecn2.MIT_ID
) pub ON pub.MIT_ID = ecn.MIT_ID
GROUP BY ml_all.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ecn.FULL_NAME
ORDER BY ecn.FULL_NAME

rows.question: For each unique mailing list with a name beginning with R (case insensitive), and that Professor Ayden Hopkins is subscribed to, list its name, description, owner, number of people in the list, and number of tenured faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH mailing_list_master AS (
SELECT
  `drupal_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS `SUBJECT_CODE`
FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
GROUP BY `drupal_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE`
),
person_directory_normalized AS (
SELECT
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`MIT_ID` AS `MIT_ID`,
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`FULL_NAME` AS `FULL_NAME`,
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`FIRST_NAME` AS `FIRST_NAME`,
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`MIDDLE_NAME` AS `MIDDLE_NAME`,
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`LAST_NAME` AS `LAST_NAME`,
  `drupal_employee_directory`.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` AS `EMAIL_ADDRESS`
FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
)
SELECT
  ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS name,
  ml.`MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION` AS description,
  mlo.`OWNER` AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`) AS member_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.`PAYROLL_RANK` = 'Faculty Tenured' THEN mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` END) AS tenured_faculty_count
FROM moira_list_detail mld
JOIN moira_list ml ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`

rows.question: For students with last names starting with H who are subscribed to mailing list 'beacon-date-date', list the names of the students, the phone numbers of departments they belong to, and the size of the mailing list 'beacon-date-date' that they are subscribed to.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH department_directory AS (
  SELECT
    sis.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT_ORG_UNIT_ID,
    -- prefer area code + number if both present, else whichever phone field exists
    CASE
      WHEN TRIM(CONCAT_WS('', sis.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, sis.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER)) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(sis.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, ''), NULLIF(sis.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, ''))
    END AS DEPT_PHONE
  FROM sis_admin_department sis
  WHERE
    -- only keep departments that have some phone info per requirement
    NOT (COALESCE(NULLIF(sis.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, ''), '') = '' 
         AND COALESCE(NULLIF(sis.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, ''), '') = '')
  GROUP BY sis.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPT_PHONE
),
ml_size AS (
  -- size (distinct members) for the specific mailing list name
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)) AS mailing_list_size
  FROM moira_list ml
  JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
)
SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name,
  msd.LAST_NAME AS student_last_name,
  msd.FIRST_NAME AS student_first_name,
  dd.DEPT_PHONE AS department_phone_number,
  'beacon-date-date' AS mailing_list_name,
  mls.mailing_list_size AS mailing_list_size
FROM mit_student_directory msd
JOIN department_directory dd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = dd.DEPT_ORG_UNIT_ID
JOIN moira_list ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
JOIN ml_size mls
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  -- match student by MIT ID if available in moira detail, otherwise try full name
  AND (
    (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = msd.FULL_NAME)
    OR mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = msd.FULL_NAME
    OR mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME
  )
WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'H%' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci

rows.question: For each mailing group, list its owner, owner type, the member visibility ('Public Members' if public, and 'Hidden Members' otherwise), and the number of members of this type of visibility. For each owner and owner type, include a grand total for all members in the format of (owner, owner type, null, total members).

WITH mailing_group_owner_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    lo.`OWNER` AS OWNER,
    CASE WHEN ml.`IS_MOIRA_GROUP` = 'Y' THEN 'MOIRA' ELSE lo.`OWNER_TYPE` END AS OWNER_TYPE,
    ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` AS MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.`IS_PUBLIC` AS IS_PUBLIC
  FROM `moira_list` ml
  LEFT JOIN `moira_list_owner` lo
    ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = lo.`MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY`
),
mailing_group_member_counts_by_owner_visibility AS (
  SELECT
    mgn.OWNER,
    mgn.OWNER_TYPE,
    -- interpret IS_PUBLIC: 'Y' => public, else not public
    CASE WHEN mgn.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_PUBLIC,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`) AS MEMBER_COUNT
  FROM mailing_group_owner_normalized mgn
  JOIN `moira_list_detail` mld
    ON mgn.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  -- only consider mailing-group-related rows: include rows from moira_list (all rows already represent mailing groups)
  GROUP BY
    mgn.OWNER,
    mgn.OWNER_TYPE,
    CASE WHEN mgn.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
)
SELECT
  OWNER,
  OWNER_TYPE,
  CASE WHEN IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END AS MEMBER_VISIBILITY,
  MEMBER_COUNT
FROM mailing_group_member_counts_by_owner_visibility

UNION ALL

SELECT
  OWNER,
  OWNER_TYPE,
  NULL AS MEMBER_VISIBILITY,
  SUM(MEMBER_COUNT) AS MEMBER_COUNT
FROM mailing_group_member_counts_by_owner_visibility
GROUP BY OWNER, OWNER_TYPE

ORDER BY
  OWNER ASC,
  OWNER_TYPE ASC,
  CASE
    WHEN MEMBER_VISIBILITY = 'Public Members' THEN 1
    WHEN MEMBER_VISIBILITY = 'Hidden Members' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END ASC

rows.question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. For each group, list the name of the department, the course title, cluster type, total enrollments, average enrollment within its cluster, course level, number of unique course materials, average new and used prices for TIP materials, total material record count for TIP materials, number of unique library titles, and number of unique library ISBNs.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH materials_tip_and_library_by_course_section AS (
  SELECT
    tso.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    tso.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    tm.ISBN AS ISBN,
    tm.TITLE AS TIP_TITLE,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE AS USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    COALESCE(tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE,'TIP') AS MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE,
    lrc.CATALOG_TITLE AS CATALOG_TITLE,
    lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS CATALOG_ISBN,
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
    lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
    ON lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
       OR (lrm.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID)
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
),
course_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    so.SECTION_ID,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS CHAR)), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS CHAR)), ''),
        '0'
      ) + 0
    ) AS total_enrollment
  FROM subject_offered so
  GROUP BY so.SECTION_ID, so.SUBJECT_ID
),
materials_agg AS (
  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(ISBN,'')) AS unique_course_materials,
    AVG(CASE WHEN MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'TIP' THEN NEW_SHELF_PRICE END) AS avg_new_price_tip,
    AVG(CASE WHEN MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'TIP' THEN USED_SHELF_PRICE END) AS avg_used_price_tip,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'TIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_tip_material_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(CATALOG_TITLE,'')) AS unique_library_titles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(CATALOG_ISBN,'')) AS unique_library_isbns
  FROM materials_tip_and_library_by_course_section
  GROUP BY SECTION_ID
)
SELECT
  ccso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
  ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  ccso.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  COALESCE(ce.total_enrollment,0) AS total_enrollments,
  ROUND(
    AVG(COALESCE(ce.total_enrollment,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.CLUSTER_TYPE),
    2
  ) AS avg_enrollment_in_cluster,
  NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(COALESCE(ccso.COURSE_NUMBER,''),'^[0-9]+'), '') AS course_level,
  COALESCE(ma.unique_course_materials,0) AS unique_course_materials,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ma.avg_new_price_tip,0),2) AS avg_new_price_tip,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ma.avg_used_price_tip,0),2) AS avg_used_price_tip,
  COALESCE(ma.total_tip_material_records,0) AS total_tip_material_records,
  COALESCE(ma.unique_library_titles,0) AS unique_library_titles,
  COALESCE(ma.unique_library_isbns,0) AS unique_library_isbns
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
LEFT JOIN course_enrollment ce
  ON ce.SECTION_ID = ccso.SECTION_ID
  AND ce.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN materials_agg ma
  ON ma.SECTION_ID = ccso.SECTION_ID
WHERE ccso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.

    AND (

      OR
      (`IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM` IS NOT NULL AND `IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM` <> '')
    )
),

  SELECT
    at.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`,''), at_all.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`,''), at_all.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`) AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`

),
