        ELSE c.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`
      END
    ) AS CANONICAL_LEVEL,
    c.`FALL_INSTRUCTORS` AS RAW_FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    c.`SPRING_INSTRUCTORS` AS RAW_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,
    -- normalize separators to commas and collapse consecutive separators/spaces
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM
        REPLACE(
          REPLACE(
            REPLACE(
              REPLACE(COALESCE(c.`FALL_INSTRUCTORS`, ''), ';', ','),
            '|', ','),
          '/', ','),
        '\\', ',')
      ), ''
    ) AS CLEAN_FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM
        REPLACE(
          REPLACE(
            REPLACE(
              REPLACE(COALESCE(c.`SPRING_INSTRUCTORS`, ''), ';', ','),
            '|', ','),
          '/', ','),
        '\\', ',')
      ), ''
    ) AS CLEAN_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM course_catalog_subjects_this_year_offering_flags c
),
instructor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    slc.SUBJECT_ID,
    slc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    -- fall count
    CASE
      WHEN slc.CLEAN_FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(slc.CLEAN_FALL_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(val)) FROM (
          SELECT TRIM(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(slc.CLEAN_FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1)
          ) AS val
          FROM (
            SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
            UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
            UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
          ) numbers
          WHERE numbers.n <= 1 + LENGTH(slc.CLEAN_FALL_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(slc.CLEAN_FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', ''))
        ) split_vals
        WHERE val <> ''
      )
    END AS FALL_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT,
    -- spring count
    CASE
      WHEN slc.CLEAN_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(slc.CLEAN_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(val)) FROM (
          SELECT TRIM(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(slc.CLEAN_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1)
          ) AS val
          FROM (
            SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
            UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
            UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
          ) numbers
          WHERE numbers.n <= 1 + LENGTH(slc.CLEAN_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(slc.CLEAN_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', ''))
        ) split_vals
        WHERE val <> ''
      )
    END AS SPRING_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT
  FROM subject_level_and_clean_instructors slc
)
SELECT
  t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  NULL AS school_name,
  t.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
  t.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  COALESCE(s.CANONICAL_LEVEL, t.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_level,
  t.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units,
  t.OFFERED_TERM AS offered_term,
  tc.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COALESCE(ic.FALL_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT, 0) AS fall_instructor_count,
  COALESCE(ic.SPRING_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT, 0) AS spring_instructor_count
FROM (
  -- produce one row per subject per offered season
  SELECT
    ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    ccs.SUBJECT_ID,
    ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ccs.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    ccs.TOTAL_UNITS,
    'Fall' AS OFFERED_TERM
  FROM course_catalog_subjects_this_year_offering_flags ccs
  WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    ccs.SUBJECT_ID,
    ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ccs.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    ccs.TOTAL_UNITS,
    'Spring' AS OFFERED_TERM
  FROM course_catalog_subjects_this_year_offering_flags ccs
  WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y'
) AS t
LEFT JOIN term_code_to_description_and_season tc
  ON t.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = tc.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_level_and_clean_instructors s
  ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID
  AND s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN instructor_counts ic
  ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID
  AND ic.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
ORDER BY department_name, subject_id, offered_term

rows.question: For Political Science courses with HASS attributes, for each attribute, list the name and description of the attribute, the number of unique subjects, average units, the total enrollment, the number of departments that grant degrees, and the subject code description.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH cis_hass_attribute_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    `HASS_ATTRIBUTE` AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    `DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM` AS DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM,
    `DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN` AS DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN
  FROM `cis_hass_attribute`
)
SELECT
  ch.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM AS attribute_name,
  ch.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN AS attribute_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subjects,
  AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_units,
  NULL AS total_enrollment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN sd.DEPARTMENT END) AS departments_granting_degrees,
  MIN(c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION) AS subject_code_description
FROM cis_course_catalog c
JOIN cis_hass_attribute_lookup ch
  ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = ch.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
LEFT JOIN sis_course_description sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
  AND c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL
  AND c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE <> ''
GROUP BY ch.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ch.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN
ORDER BY unique_subjects DESC

rows.question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. For each group, list the cluster type, name of the department, school name, whether the department grants degrees, total number of subjects, total enrollment, and average enrollment. Exclude clusters or schools with no student data.
rows.pred_sql:
-- Revised query: verifies columns, uses SUBJECT_ID, SO_CLUSTER_TYPE from drupal_course_catalog,
-- uses subject_offered.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER for enrollment, joins on term (EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE -> TERM_CODE),
-- counts distinct SUBJECT_ID, excludes groups with total_enrollment IS NULL or <= 0, orders by total_enrollment desc.

WITH course_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    dcc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE AS SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
    dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(dcc.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM drupal_course_catalog dcc
),
-- per-subject enrollment in a term: use subject_offered.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER (integer)
per_subject_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    MAX(COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  FROM subject_offered so
  GROUP BY so.TERM_CODE, so.SUBJECT_ID
)

SELECT
  cs.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE               AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
  cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME               AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME                   AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- infer degree-granting from sis_department.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING if available, else NULL
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING            AS DEPARTMENT_GRANTS_DEGREES,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.SUBJECT_ID)    AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS,
  SUM(pse.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  -- average enrollment per distinct subject (use numeric division)
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT cs.SUBJECT_ID) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(pse.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) / COUNT(DISTINCT cs.SUBJECT_ID)
  END AS AVG_ENROLLMENT_PER_SUBJECT
FROM course_subjects cs
-- join to enrollment by subject + term
JOIN per_subject_enrollment pse
  ON pse.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID
  AND pse.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE
-- attempt to attach department metadata (may not match perfectly by name)
LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME
GROUP BY
  cs.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
HAVING
  SUM(pse.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) IS NOT NULL
  AND SUM(pse.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 0
ORDER BY TOTAL_ENROLLMENT DESC

rows.question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_core AS (
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`
FROM `buildings`
),
course_section_meetings_137 AS (
SELECT
  cso.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
  cso.MEET_PLACE AS MEET_PLACE,
  cso.MEET_TIME AS MEET_TIME,
  cso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  cso.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
  cso.TOTAL_UNITS AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  dcc.SECTION_ID AS dcc_SECTION_ID,
  dcc.MEET_PLACE AS dcc_MEET_PLACE,
  dcc.MEET_TIME AS dcc_MEET_TIME,
  dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS dcc_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  dcc.SUBJECT_ID AS dcc_SUBJECT_ID,
  dcc.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS dcc_SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS dcc_EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
  dcc.TOTAL_UNITS AS dcc_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cso
LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dcc
  ON dcc.SECTION_ID = cso.SECTION_ID
  AND dcc.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID
  AND dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
WHERE cso.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
  AND cso.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
),
building_basic AS (
SELECT
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS` AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS` AS BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS,
  `buildings`.`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  `buildings`.`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_COUNTER` AS BUILDING_COUNTER,
  `buildings`.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM `buildings`
GROUP BY
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_KEY`,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_NAME`,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS`,
  `buildings`.`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  `buildings`.`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,
  `buildings`.`BUILDING_COUNTER`,
  `buildings`.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
)
SELECT
  -- room_number: text after last space in MEET_PLACE (common room style "Building Number Room")
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_PLACE, ' ', -1)) AS room_number,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  -- building_number: first token of MEET_PLACE (common "BUILDING ROOM" or "BUILDING_NUMBER ROOM")
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1)) AS building_number,
  -- building_city/state are not available on building_basic; attempt from fclt_building_address if present by joining on building_number
  COALESCE(fba.CITY, NULL) AS building_city,
  COALESCE(fba.STATE, NULL) AS building_state,
  -- area: use gross square footage from building_basic
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS area,
  -- organization_name: use SUBJECT_ID as the closest available organization identifier (SIS abbreviation not needed in data)
  c.SUBJECT_ID AS organization_name,
  -- room_usage: no direct column available in the provided views for usage; use NULL
  NULL AS room_usage,
  c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  -- course_level: derive from SUBJECT_NUMBER leading digits (take first character(s) before any non-digit)
  NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+'), '') AS course_level,
  -- total_subjects: count distinct subject ids for this section (aggregated)
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  -- unique_meeting_times: distinct meet_time values for the section
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.MEET_TIME) AS unique_meeting_times,
  -- total_units: take the MAX TOTAL_UNITS for the section (section-level attribute)
  MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
FROM
  course_section_meetings_137 c
LEFT JOIN
  building_basic b
  ON TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1)) = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN
  fclt_building_address fba
  ON TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1)) = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER
-- one row per section (section-level), so group by section identifiers and all non-aggregated selected expressions
GROUP BY
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_PLACE, ' ', -1)),
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1)),
  COALESCE(fba.CITY, NULL),
  COALESCE(fba.STATE, NULL),
  b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  c.SUBJECT_ID,
  c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
  NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+'), '')

rows.question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- catalog items joined to their library material status and department (from library_reserve_matrl_detail -> catalog -> subject_offered)
catalog_items AS (
  SELECT
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` AS catalog_key,
    lrmd.`TERM_CODE` AS term_code,
    lrmd.`SUBJECT_ID` AS subject_id,
    lrc.`CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE` AS catalog_record_update_date,
    lrc.`CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE` AS catalog_record_create_date,
    lrc.`CATALOG_YEAR` AS catalog_year,
    lso.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME` AS department_name,
    lso.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS department_code,
    COALESCE(lso.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, 0) AS num_enrolled_students,
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` AS material_status_key
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` lrc
    ON lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
    ON lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
),
-- material status text
material_status_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` AS material_status_key,
    `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS material_status
  FROM `library_material_status`
),
-- choose a catalog date and filter on or after 2000-01-01
filtered_catalog AS (
  SELECT
    ci.catalog_key,
    ci.subject_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ci.department_name, ''), NULL) AS department_name,
    COALESCE(ci.department_code, NULL) AS department_code,
    ci.num_enrolled_students,
    COALESCE(msl.material_status, 'Unknown') AS material_status
  FROM catalog_items ci
  LEFT JOIN material_status_lookup msl
    ON ci.material_status_key = msl.material_status_key
  WHERE
    -- determine a date value from available catalog fields and require year >= 2000
    (
      -- try full create/update date as yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy/mm/dd or other parseable forms
      (ci.catalog_record_update_date IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         (STR_TO_DATE(ci.catalog_record_update_date, '%Y-%m-%d') IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(ci.catalog_record_update_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE('2000-01-01'))
         OR (STR_TO_DATE(ci.catalog_record_update_date, '%Y/%m/%d') IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(ci.catalog_record_update_date, '%Y/%m/%d') >= DATE('2000-01-01'))
         OR (ci.catalog_record_update_date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}' AND CAST(LEFT(ci.catalog_record_update_date,4) AS UNSIGNED) >= 2000)
       )
      )
      OR
      (ci.catalog_record_create_date IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         (STR_TO_DATE(ci.catalog_record_create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(ci.catalog_record_create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE('2000-01-01'))
         OR (STR_TO_DATE(ci.catalog_record_create_date, '%Y/%m/%d') IS NOT NULL AND STR_TO_DATE(ci.catalog_record_create_date, '%Y/%m/%d') >= DATE('2000-01-01'))
         OR (ci.catalog_record_create_date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}' AND CAST(LEFT(ci.catalog_record_create_date,4) AS UNSIGNED) >= 2000)
       )
      )
      OR
      (ci.catalog_year IS NOT NULL
       AND ci.catalog_year REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$'
       AND CAST(ci.catalog_year AS UNSIGNED) >= 2000
      )
    )
),
-- detail rows: per material_status x department
detail AS (
  SELECT
    fc.material_status AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COALESCE(fc.department_name, 'Unknown') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fc.catalog_key) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    SUM(fc.num_enrolled_students) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM filtered_catalog fc
  GROUP BY fc.material_status, COALESCE(fc.department_name, 'Unknown')
),
-- subtotals per material_status
subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'Subtotal' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    SUM(TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY MATERIAL_STATUS
),
-- grand total across all statuses/departments
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'Grand Total' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    SUM(TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM detail
)
-- combine detail, subtotals and grand total
SELECT MATERIAL_STATUS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT, TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
) t
ORDER BY
  -- ensure Grand Total last
  CASE WHEN MATERIAL_STATUS = 'Grand Total' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END,
  MATERIAL_STATUS,
  -- ensure subtotal after departments for each status
  CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Subtotal' THEN 2 WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Grand Total' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: For each course with enrolled students and with books in the library system, list the name of the department of that course, total number of courses using library materials, the number of catalog items associated with those courses, and the average enrollment per course. Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_department_master AS (
SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
FROM
  cis_course_catalog c
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cdm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS department,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cdm.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
  COUNT(lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS number_of_catalog_items,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT cdm.SUBJECT_ID), 2) AS average_enrollment_per_course
FROM course_department_master cdm
JOIN library_subject_offered lso
  ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cdm.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
  ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = cdm.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  ON so.SUBJECT_ID = cdm.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE (
    COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)
) > 0
GROUP BY cdm.DEPARTMENT_NAME

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS department,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cdm.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
  COUNT(lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS number_of_catalog_items,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT cdm.SUBJECT_ID), 2) AS average_enrollment_per_course
FROM course_department_master cdm
JOIN library_subject_offered lso
  ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cdm.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
  ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = cdm.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  ON so.SUBJECT_ID = cdm.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE (
    COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)
) > 0

rows.question: For each department and school offering courses with materials, list the department name, school name, number of unique course materials, number of courses, average new and used shelf prices of materials, total material records, and number of distinct material statuses. Include a grand total across all schools and departments (the corresponding school and department fields should be null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH dept_map AS (
  -- map section/course identifiers to department name when available in drupal_course_catalog
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS department_name_only
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
  WHERE `SECTION_ID` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(tso.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, dm.department_name_only) AS department_name,
  tso.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME` AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`) AS unique_course_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`) AS number_of_courses,
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(tm.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE`, 0)), 2) AS average_new_shelf_price,
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(tm.`USED_SHELF_PRICE`, 0)), 2) AS average_used_shelf_price,
  COUNT(td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`) AS total_material_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM `tip_subject_offered` tso
LEFT JOIN dept_map dm
  ON dm.`SECTION_ID` = tso.`SECTION_ID`
JOIN `tip_detail` td
  ON td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `tip_material` tm
  ON tm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `tip_material_status` tms
  ON tms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = td.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
WHERE tso.`IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL` = 'N'
GROUP BY COALESCE(tso.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`, dm.department_name_only), tso.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`

UNION ALL

-- grand total row (department_name and school_name NULL)
SELECT
  NULL AS department_name,
  NULL AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`) AS unique_course_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`) AS number_of_courses,
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(tm.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE`, 0)), 2) AS average_new_shelf_price,
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(tm.`USED_SHELF_PRICE`, 0)), 2) AS average_used_shelf_price,
  COUNT(td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`) AS total_material_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT td.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`) AS distinct_material_statuses
FROM `tip_subject_offered` tso
JOIN `tip_detail` td
  ON td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `tip_material` tm
  ON tm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `tip_material_status` tms
  ON tms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = td.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
WHERE tso.`IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL` = 'N'
ORDER BY
  -- put the grand total last (NULLs last), then by school and department
  (school_name IS NULL) ASC, school_name ASC, (department_name IS NULL) ASC, department_name ASC

rows.question: For each TIP material status, list the total number of unique materials associated with the status, the total number of records associated with the status, and the total student enrollment associated with the status. Any material status with null values should be displayed as 'No material status'. Additionally, include a grand total across all material status (the material status for this row should be displayed as 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH tip_with_status AS (
  SELECT
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    td.RECORD_COUNT,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM tip_detail td
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON td.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
    AND td.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID
)
, status_labels AS (
  SELECT
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    COALESCE(tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'No material status') AS material_status
  FROM tip_material_status tms
  UNION
  -- ensure we include statuses referenced in tip_detail even if missing from tip_material_status
  SELECT
    DISTINCT tws.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
    COALESCE(tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'No material status')
  FROM tip_with_status tws
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status tms2
    ON tws.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
)
, agg_by_status AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(sl.material_status, 'No material status') AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tws.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_unique_materials,
    COALESCE(SUM(tws.RECORD_COUNT),0) AS total_records,
    COALESCE(SUM(tws.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS),0) AS total_student_enrollment
  FROM tip_with_status tws
  LEFT JOIN status_labels sl
    ON tws.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = sl.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY COALESCE(sl.material_status, 'No material status')
)
, grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_unique_materials,
    COALESCE(SUM(RECORD_COUNT),0) AS total_records,
    COALESCE(SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS),0) AS total_student_enrollment
  FROM tip_with_status
)
SELECT 'material_status,total_unique_materials,total_records,total_student_enrollment' AS header
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    '"', material_status, '",',
    total_unique_materials, ',',
    total_records, ',',
    total_student_enrollment
  )
FROM agg_by_status
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    '"', material_status, '",',
    total_unique_materials, ',',
    total_records, ',',
    total_student_enrollment
  )
FROM grand_total

rows.question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. Include subtotals across floors, subtotals across all floors for each building, and a grand total across all buildings. For the subtotal for each building and the grand total, the percentage of area should be relative to area of all buildings. All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH room_rows AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    COALESCE(sf.FLOOR, fclt.FLOOR, zf.FLOOR) AS floor_number,
    COALESCE(fac.ROOM, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, zf.BUILDING_ROOM, fclt.ROOM) AS room_number,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type,
    COALESCE(fclt.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') AS organization_name,
    1 AS number_of_rooms,
    COALESCE(fac.AREA, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, fclt.AREA, 0) AS area,
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key
  FROM fac_building b
  LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fac
    ON fac.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN space_detail sd
    ON sd.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    AND (sd.ROOM_NUMBER = fac.ROOM OR sd.BUILDING_ROOM = fac.BUILDING_ROOM)
  LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fclt
    ON fclt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
    AND (fclt.ROOM = fac.ROOM OR fclt.BUILDING_ROOM = fac.BUILDING_ROOM)
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization_hist fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fclt.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN space_floor sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = COALESCE(fac.FLOOR_KEY, fclt.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fac.FLOOR)
  LEFT JOIN zpm_rooms_load zf
    ON (zf.BUILDING_ROOM = fac.BUILDING_ROOM OR zf.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM OR zf.BUILDING_ROOM = fclt.BUILDING_ROOM)
  WHERE b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
agg_floor AS (
  SELECT
    building_key,
    building_name,
    floor_number,
    NULL AS room_number,
    NULL AS ownership_type,
    NULL AS organization_name,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(area) AS area
  FROM room_rows
  GROUP BY building_key, building_name, floor_number
),
agg_building AS (
  SELECT
    building_key,
    building_name,
    NULL AS floor_number,
    NULL AS room_number,
    NULL AS ownership_type,
    NULL AS organization_name,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(area) AS area
  FROM room_rows
  GROUP BY building_key, building_name
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS building_key,
    'Grand Total' AS building_name,
    NULL AS floor_number,
    NULL AS room_number,
    NULL AS ownership_type,
    NULL AS organization_name,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(area) AS area
  FROM room_rows
),
combined AS (
  SELECT building_key, building_name, floor_number, room_number, ownership_type, organization_name, number_of_rooms, area FROM room_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT building_key, building_name, floor_number, room_number, ownership_type, organization_name, number_of_rooms, area FROM agg_floor
  UNION ALL
  SELECT building_key, building_name, floor_number, room_number, ownership_type, organization_name, number_of_rooms, area FROM agg_building
  UNION ALL
  SELECT building_key, building_name, floor_number, room_number, ownership_type, organization_name, number_of_rooms, area FROM grand_total
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(area) AS total_all_buildings FROM agg_building
)
SELECT
  combined.building_name,
  COALESCE(combined.floor_number, '') AS floor_number,
  COALESCE(combined.room_number, '') AS room_number,
  COALESCE(combined.ownership_type, '') AS ownership_type,
  COALESCE(combined.organization_name, '') AS organization_name,
  FORMAT(ROUND(combined.number_of_rooms),0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(combined.area),0) AS area,
  CASE
    WHEN combined.building_name = 'Grand Total' THEN
      IFNULL(FORMAT(ROUND((combined.area / NULLIF(totals.total_all_buildings,0)) * 100, 2), 2), '0.00')
    WHEN combined.floor_number IS NULL AND combined.room_number IS NULL AND combined.building_name <> 'Grand Total' THEN
      -- building subtotal: percent relative to total of all buildings
      IFNULL(FORMAT(ROUND((combined.area / NULLIF(totals.total_all_buildings,0)) * 100, 2), 2), '0.00')
    ELSE
      -- detail row or floor subtotal: percent relative to building total
      IFNULL(
        FORMAT(
          ROUND(
            (combined.area /
              NULLIF(
                (SELECT ab.area FROM agg_building ab WHERE ab.building_key = combined.building_key LIMIT 1)
            , 0)
            ) * 100
          , 2)
        , 2)
      , '0.00')
  END AS area_percentage
FROM combined
CROSS JOIN totals
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN combined.building_name = 'Grand Total' THEN 4
    WHEN combined.floor_number IS NULL AND combined.room_number IS NULL AND combined.building_name IS NOT NULL THEN 3
    WHEN combined.room_number IS NULL THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END,
  combined.building_name,
  COALESCE(combined.floor_number, ''),
  COALESCE(combined.room_number, '')

rows.question: For each financial aid year and academic year, list the number of fiscal periods, quarters, the start term date, the end term date, and number of distinct department-level term parameters.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  a.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  a.fiscal_period_count AS fiscal_period_count,
  -- If TERM_SELECTOR isn't available for a combination, quarter_count will be NULL per requirements
  a.quarter_count AS quarter_count,
  a.term_start_date AS term_start_date,
  a.term_end_date AS term_end_date,
  COALESCE(tp.num_distinct_department_term_parameters, 0) AS distinct_department_term_parameter_count
FROM (
  /* aggregate terms by FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR / ACADEMIC_YEAR */
  SELECT
    at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT at.TERM_CODE) AS fiscal_period_count,
    -- TERM_SELECTOR may be NULL; use COUNT(DISTINCT) which will return 0 if all nulls, convert 0 to NULL to reflect "not available"
    NULLIF(CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT at.TERM_SELECTOR) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT at.TERM_SELECTOR) END, 0) AS quarter_count,
    MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS term_start_date,
    MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS term_end_date
  FROM academic_terms AS at
  WHERE at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR <> ''
    AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR <> ''
  GROUP BY at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
) AS a
LEFT JOIN (
  /* link term parameters to terms to determine their FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR / ACADEMIC_YEAR, then count distinct TERM_PARAMETER */
  SELECT
    at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT atp.TERM_PARAMETER) AS num_distinct_department_term_parameters
  FROM academic_term_parameter AS atp
  JOIN academic_terms AS at
    ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  WHERE at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR <> ''
    AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR <> ''
    AND atp.TERM_PARAMETER IS NOT NULL AND atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> ''
  GROUP BY at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
) AS tp
  ON tp.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = a.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
  AND tp.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY a.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ASC, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ASC

rows.question: Group buildings by campus sectors. For each group, list the campus sector, name of the building, city and state where the building is located, total number of floors, total assignable area, total number of rooms, total number of organizations, ownership type, and a rank column indicating the order (1-indexed) of this row within each sector based on the descending order of assignable area. Include subtotals for each sector and a grand total across all sectors. The subtotal and grand total only need to computed over the total number of floors and assignable area.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS,
    -- The schema doesn't provide a CAMPUS_SECTOR column. Use BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS city part if available,
    -- otherwise fall back to BUILDING_NAME as a sector placeholder per instructions to restrict to buildings table.
    -- Extract a simple campus sector candidate as the first token of mailing address (if any) or BUILDING_NAME.
    CASE
      WHEN b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS <> ''
        THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS, ',', 1))
      WHEN b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS <> ''
        THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, ',', 1))
      ELSE b.BUILDING_NAME
    END AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    CAST(COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS SIGNED) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    CAST(COALESCE(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS SIGNED) AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    CAST(COALESCE(b.BUILDING_COUNTER, 0) AS SIGNED) AS BUILDING_COUNTER,
    b.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM buildings b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> ''
    AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER <> ''
),

rooms_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, '') AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, '')) AS total_organizations
  FROM fclt_rooms
  GROUP BY COALESCE(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, '')
),

buildings_with_counts AS (
  SELECT
    bc.*,
    COALESCE(r.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms,
    COALESCE(r.total_organizations, 0) AS total_organizations,
    -- Ownership type not present in schema; leave as NULL to reflect stored value if absent.
    NULL AS ownership_type
  FROM buildings_core bc
  LEFT JOIN rooms_per_building r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
),

detail_rows AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR AS campus_sector,
    BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    -- attempt to parse city/state from mailing address: city is token before last comma, state is last token if two-part at end like "City, State"
    NULLIF(TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS LIKE '%,%' THEN
          -- take second-to-last part as city when there are at least two parts
          TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS, ',', -2), ',', 1))
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ), '') AS city,
    NULLIF(TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS LIKE '%,%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS, ',', -1))
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ), '') AS state,
    BUILDING_COUNTER AS total_floors,
    BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS total_assignable_area,
    total_rooms,
    total_organizations,
    ownership_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY CAMPUS_SECTOR
      ORDER BY BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC, BUILDING_NAME ASC
    ) AS sector_rank,
    1 AS sort_group,
    BUILDING_KEY
  FROM buildings_with_counts
),

sector_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR AS campus_sector,
    'Subtotal' AS building_name,
    NULL AS city,
    NULL AS state,
    SUM(COALESCE(BUILDING_COUNTER, 0)) AS total_floors,
    SUM(COALESCE(BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0)) AS total_assignable_area,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS total_organizations,
    NULL AS ownership_type,
    NULL AS sector_rank,
    2 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS BUILDING_KEY
  FROM buildings_with_counts
  GROUP BY CAMPUS_SECTOR
),

grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS campus_sector,
    'Grand Total' AS building_name,
    NULL AS city,
    NULL AS state,
    SUM(COALESCE(BUILDING_COUNTER, 0)) AS total_floors,
    SUM(COALESCE(BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0)) AS total_assignable_area,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS total_organizations,
    NULL AS ownership_type,
    NULL AS sector_rank,
    3 AS sort_group,
    NULL AS BUILDING_KEY
  FROM buildings_with_counts
)

SELECT
  campus_sector AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  building_name AS BUILDING_NAME,
  city AS CITY,
  state AS STATE,
  CAST(total_floors AS SIGNED) AS TOTAL_FLOORS,
  CAST(total_assignable_area AS SIGNED) AS ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  CAST(COALESCE(total_rooms, 0) AS SIGNED) AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
  CAST(COALESCE(total_organizations, 0) AS SIGNED) AS TOTAL_ORGANIZATIONS,
  ownership_type AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  sector_rank AS SECTOR_RANK
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM sector_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
) t
ORDER BY
  -- ensure Grand Total is last
  CASE WHEN campus_sector = 'Grand Total' THEN 'ZZZZZZZZ' ELSE campus_sector END,
  sort_group,
  -- within detail rows (sort_group=1) order by rank (ascending), tie-breaker building_name
  COALESCE(sector_rank, 999999),
  building_name

rows.question: For each department, list the name of the department, the title of the TIP material associated with the department, author, ISBN, library term code, and whether it is available in the library reserves ('Available in Library' if yes and 'Not Available in Library' otherwise), the total number of instructors per library book for the department, the total number of materials available in the library for the department, and the total number of available materials across all departments.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subject_master AS (
  SELECT
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
  FROM `cis_course_catalog`
  WHERE `DEPARTMENT_NAME` IS NOT NULL
),
tip_materials_distinct AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    `TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    `TITLE`,
    `AUTHOR`,
    `ISBN`
  FROM `tip_material`
),
-- associate tip materials to subjects & term from tip_detail
tip_detail_subject AS (
  SELECT
    `TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `TERM_CODE`
  FROM `tip_detail`
  WHERE `TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` IS NOT NULL
),
-- library reserve linkage rows enriched with any TIP_MATERIAL_KEY from matching subject+term in tip_detail
library_linked AS (
  SELECT
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
    lrmd.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`,
    lrmd.`TERM_CODE`,
    lrmd.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail_subject td
    ON td.`SUBJECT_ID` = lrmd.`SUBJECT_ID`
    AND td.`TERM_CODE` = lrmd.`TERM_CODE`
),
-- per subject+tip material: whether present in library and count distinct instructors (using instructor key or name if key null)
lib_availability_by_subject_material AS (
  SELECT
    ll.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    ll.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ll.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_library,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      COALESCE(ll.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`, ll.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`)
    ) AS instructors_per_book
  FROM library_linked ll
  GROUP BY ll.`SUBJECT_ID`, ll.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
),
-- per-department count of distinct available materials (count distinct TIP_MATERIAL_KEY that have a library linkage)
dept_material_counts AS (
  SELECT
    csm.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lav.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`) AS materials_in_library_for_dept
  FROM course_subject_master csm
  JOIN tip_detail_subject td
    ON td.`SUBJECT_ID` = csm.`SUBJECT_ID`
  JOIN library_linked ll
    ON ll.`SUBJECT_ID` = td.`SUBJECT_ID` AND ll.`TERM_CODE` = td.`TERM_CODE`
  JOIN lib_availability_by_subject_material lav
    ON lav.`SUBJECT_ID` = ll.`SUBJECT_ID` AND lav.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = ll.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
  WHERE lav.has_library = 1 AND lav.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY csm.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`
),
-- global total distinct available materials across all departments
global_total AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT lav.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`) AS total_available_materials_across_all_departments
  FROM lib_availability_by_subject_material lav
  WHERE lav.has_library = 1 AND lav.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  csm.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  tm.`TITLE` AS TIP_TITLE,
  tm.`AUTHOR` AS TIP_AUTHOR,
  tm.`ISBN` AS TIP_ISBN,
  td.`TERM_CODE` AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(lav.has_library,0) = 1 THEN 'Available in Library' ELSE 'Not Available in Library' END AS AVAILABLE_IN_LIBRARY,
  COALESCE(lav.instructors_per_book, 0) AS INSTRUCTORS_PER_BOOK,
  COALESCE(dmc.materials_in_library_for_dept, 0) AS MATERIALS_IN_LIBRARY_FOR_DEPT,
  COALESCE(gt.total_available_materials_across_all_departments, 0) AS TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MATERIALS_ACROSS_ALL_DEPTS
FROM course_subject_master csm
-- link to tip_detail to find materials associated with the subject
LEFT JOIN tip_detail_subject td
  ON td.`SUBJECT_ID` = csm.`SUBJECT_ID`
-- material metadata
LEFT JOIN tip_materials_distinct tm
  ON tm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
-- library availability & instructor counts per subject+material
LEFT JOIN lib_availability_by_subject_material lav
  ON lav.`SUBJECT_ID` = td.`SUBJECT_ID`
  AND lav.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
-- per-department material counts
LEFT JOIN dept_material_counts dmc
  ON dmc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = csm.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`
-- global total (same value on every row)
LEFT JOIN global_total gt
  ON 1=1
WHERE csm.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` IS NOT NULL

rows.question: For each building that is not a subdivision, list the building number, full name, street address, building type, occupancy date, ownership type, and site location. You should also include three rows at the end showing the number of owned, leased, all buildings at MIT that are not subdivisions, in the format of (null, #building Buildings, null, null, null, null, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS full_name,
    fa.STREET_NUMBER,
    fa.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    fa.STREET_NAME,
    fa.STREET_SUFFIX,
    fa.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
    fa.CITY,
    fa.STATE,
    fa.POSTAL_CODE,
    -- construct street_address
    TRIM(
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(fa.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
        CASE WHEN fa.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NULL OR fa.PRE_DIRECTIONAL = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', fa.PRE_DIRECTIONAL) END,
        CASE WHEN fa.STREET_NAME IS NULL OR fa.STREET_NAME = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', fa.STREET_NAME) END,
        CASE WHEN fa.STREET_SUFFIX IS NULL OR fa.STREET_SUFFIX = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', fa.STREET_SUFFIX) END,
        CASE WHEN fa.POST_DIRECTIONAL IS NULL OR fa.POST_DIRECTIONAL = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' ', fa.POST_DIRECTIONAL) END
      )
    ) AS street_address,
    COALESCE(fclt.BUILDING_TYPE, fac.BUILDING_TYPE) AS building_type,

rows.question: In ascending order of construction start year, for each owned building that is not a subdivision, list the construction start year, the building number, and the year of initial occupancy. Display the construction start year only if it differs from the previous row. If the year of initial occupancy or construction start year is unknown, display 'UNKNOWN'. You should also include a row at the end showing the total number of owned buildings that are not subdivisions, in the format of (null, #building Buildings, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    f.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    NULLIF(TRIM(f.DATE_BUILT),'') AS DATE_BUILT,
    NULLIF(TRIM(f.DATE_OCCUPIED),'') AS DATE_OCCUPIED,
    f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  FROM fclt_building f
  WHERE f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (f.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR TRIM(f.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER) = '')
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT,'%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT,'%m/%d/%Y'))
    END AS construction_start_year,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED,'%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED,'%m/%d/%Y'))
    END AS initial_occupancy_year
  FROM filtered
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY
      COALESCE(construction_start_year, 9999),
      BUILDING_NUMBER
    ) AS rn
  FROM parsed
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    LAG(construction_start_year) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(construction_start_year,9999), BUILDING_NUMBER) AS prev_year
  FROM ordered o
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN construction_start_year IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN construction_start_year = prev_year THEN ''
      ELSE CAST(construction_start_year AS CHAR)
    END AS construction_start_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    CASE WHEN initial_occupancy_year IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE CAST(initial_occupancy_year AS CHAR) END AS initial_occupancy_year,
    rn
  FROM with_prev
),
count_row AS (
  SELECT NULL AS construction_start_year,
         CONCAT(COUNT(*),' Building', IF(COUNT(*)<>1,'s','')) AS building_number,
         NULL AS initial_occupancy_year,
         (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(rn),0)+1 FROM final_rows) AS rn
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year
FROM (
  SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year, rn FROM final_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year, rn FROM count_row
) t
ORDER BY rn

rows.question: Group all buildings at MIT into either owned or leased. For each group, state the ownership type, usage type, number of buildings, gross square footage, number of rooms, and the number of associated organizations. Display the ownership type only if it differs from the previous row. Include subtotals for each group and a grand total across all groups. The subtotal and grand total rows should not include ownership type and usage type. Footage should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_src AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.SITE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,''),'Unknown') AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_USE,''),'') AS USAGE_TYPE,
    COALESCE(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    COALESCE(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 0) AS NUM_OF_ROOMS,
    fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER
  FROM fac_building fb
),
-- prefer fac_rooms for room counts; if fac_rooms not present for a building fall back to NUM_OF_ROOMS from fac_building
rooms_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
-- count distinct organizations per building from fac_rooms.organization_key if present
orgs_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS ORG_COUNT
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL
    AND fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY <> ''
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
buildings_filtered AS (
  -- only top-level MIT buildings (SITE = 'MIT' and no parent building number)
  SELECT
    bs.BUILDING_KEY,
    bs.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    bs.BUILDING_NAME,
    bs.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    bs.USAGE_TYPE,
    COALESCE(bs.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,0) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    COALESCE(rpb.ROOM_COUNT, bs.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    COALESCE(opb.ORG_COUNT, 0) AS ORG_COUNT
  FROM buildings_src bs
  LEFT JOIN rooms_per_building rpb ON bs.BUILDING_KEY = rpb.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN orgs_per_building opb ON bs.BUILDING_KEY = opb.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE COALESCE(bs.SITE,'') = 'MIT'
    AND COALESCE(bs.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER,'') = ''
),
detail_rows AS (
  -- grouping by ownership + usage
  SELECT
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    USAGE_TYPE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY) AS number_of_buildings,
    SUM(COALESCE(BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,0)) AS gross_square_footage,
    SUM(COALESCE(ROOM_COUNT,0)) AS number_of_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ORG_COUNT>0 THEN BUILDING_KEY END) AS number_of_associated_organizations_building_count,
    -- to compute distinct organizations across buildings we need org-level data; fallback: sum of distinct organization counts per building
    SUM(COALESCE(ORG_COUNT,0)) AS sum_of_org_counts_per_building
  FROM buildings_filtered
  GROUP BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE, USAGE_TYPE
),
-- compute subtotal per ownership (summing the detail rows)
subtotal_rows AS (
  SELECT
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    '' AS USAGE_TYPE,
    SUM(number_of_buildings) AS number_of_buildings,
    SUM(gross_square_footage) AS gross_square_footage,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(sum_of_org_counts_per_building) AS sum_of_org_counts_per_building,
    2 AS ordering_group,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ord_own,
    '' AS ord_use,
    0 AS rn_within_own
  FROM detail_rows
  GROUP BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE
),
detail_with_ord AS (
  SELECT
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    USAGE_TYPE,
    number_of_buildings,
    gross_square_footage,
    number_of_rooms,
    sum_of_org_counts_per_building,
    1 AS ordering_group,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ord_own,
    USAGE_TYPE AS ord_use,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE ORDER BY COALESCE(USAGE_TYPE,'')) AS rn_within_own
  FROM detail_rows
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    '' AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    '' AS USAGE_TYPE,
    SUM(number_of_buildings) AS number_of_buildings,
    SUM(gross_square_footage) AS gross_square_footage,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(sum_of_org_counts_per_building) AS sum_of_org_counts_per_building,
    3 AS ordering_group,
    '' AS ord_own,
    '' AS ord_use,
    0 AS rn_within_own
  FROM detail_rows
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    USAGE_TYPE,
    number_of_buildings,
    gross_square_footage,
    number_of_rooms,
    sum_of_org_counts_per_building,
    ordering_group,
    ord_own,
    ord_use,
    rn_within_own
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM detail_with_ord
    UNION ALL
    SELECT OWNERSHIP_TYPE, USAGE_TYPE, number_of_buildings, gross_square_footage, number_of_rooms, sum_of_org_counts_per_building, ordering_group, ord_own, ord_use, rn_within_own
    FROM subtotal_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT OWNERSHIP_TYPE, USAGE_TYPE, number_of_buildings, gross_square_footage, number_of_rooms, sum_of_org_counts_per_building, ordering_group, ord_own, ord_use, rn_within_own
    FROM grand_total
  ) x
)
SELECT
  -- show ownership type only on the first detail row of each ownership group; blank for subsequent detail rows and for subtotal/grand total
  CASE WHEN rn_within_own = 1 AND ordering_group = 1 THEN ord_own ELSE '' END AS Ownership_Type_or_blank_for_subtotals_and_grand_total,
  -- usage type shown for detail rows only; blank for subtotal and grand total rows
  CASE WHEN ordering_group = 1 THEN NULLIF(USAGE_TYPE,'') ELSE '' END AS Usage_Type_or_blank_for_subtotals_and_grand_total,
  CAST(number_of_buildings AS UNSIGNED) AS Number_of_Buildings,
  -- formatted gross square footage rounded to nearest integer with commas; treat NULL as 0
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(gross_square_footage,0)),0) AS Gross_Square_Footage,
  CAST(number_of_rooms AS UNSIGNED) AS Number_of_Rooms,
  -- Number_of_Associated_Organizations: we do not have a global distinct organization table linked to buildings in provided schema reliably,
  -- so use the sum of distinct org counts per building (best-effort). For grand/subtotals this sums appropriately.
  CAST(COALESCE(sum_of_org_counts_per_building,0) AS UNSIGNED) AS Number_of_Associated_Organizations
FROM combined
ORDER BY
  -- order ownership groups alphabetically, details first, then subtotal, grand total last
  CASE WHEN ord_own = '' THEN 'ZZZ' ELSE ord_own END,
  ordering_group,
  ord_use

rows.question: For each building use, list the type, the number of distinct buildings (excluding subdivisions) of this use, the total gross square footage of these buildings, and the number of unique organizations associated with the rooms in these buildings. If the building is used as a residence, display the usage type as "RESIDENTIAL." You should also include a row at the end showing the total number of buildings, the gross square footage, and the number of organizations across all types of building use. All numerical values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.

WITH buildings_clean AS (

orgs_per_building AS (

buildings_enriched AS (

SELECT

rows.question: For each organization except Cambridge-MIT Institute, list its ID, number, level, formatted name according to level (if level is 2, there should be 1 space before the name, if level is 3, there should be 2 space before the name, up to level 6), whether it is assignable ('ASSIGNABLE' if assignable, 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' otherwise), total area, number of rooms, and average room area. Area and number of rooms should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_room_level AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,

    fr.ROOM,

rows.question: List each building key and floor key within the department of facilities, the number of rooms, total area, average area per floor, building name, access level, zip code, and city. Include subtotals for each building and a grand total across all buildings. The subtotals and grand total should not include zip code or city. Numbers of rooms and area should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_core AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AS FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR,'') AS FLOOR,
    fr.AREA AS AREA,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY AS FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(fr.FLOOR,'') AS FLOOR,
    fr.AREA AS AREA,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE
  FROM fac_rooms fr
),
building_info AS (
  -- combine building metadata from buildings and fac_building; prefer fac_building values when present
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_NAME) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    COALESCE(fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, NULL) AS BUILDING_ACCESS_LEVEL,
    a.POSTAL_CODE AS ZIP_CODE,
    a.CITY AS CITY
  FROM buildings b
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address a ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  UNION
  -- include fac_building entries that may not be in buildings table
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS BUILDING_ACCESS_LEVEL,
    NULL AS ZIP_CODE,
    NULL AS CITY
  FROM fac_building fb
  WHERE fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY NOT IN (SELECT BUILDING_KEY FROM buildings)
),
floors_agg AS (
  -- aggregated per building + floor, restricted to DP OF FACILITIES
  SELECT
    rc.BUILDING_KEY,
    rc.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
    COUNT(*) AS rooms,
    SUM(IFNULL(rc.AREA,0)) AS total_area
  FROM fac_rooms_core rc
  WHERE COALESCE(rc.ORGANIZATION_NAME,'') = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
    AND COALESCE(rc.BUILDING_KEY,'') <> ''
  GROUP BY rc.BUILDING_KEY, rc.FLOOR
),
building_totals AS (
  -- per-building totals and number of floors (to compute avg area per floor)
  SELECT
    fa.BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(fa.total_area) AS building_total_area,
    COUNT(*) AS building_floor_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>0 THEN SUM(fa.total_area)/COUNT(*) ELSE 0 END AS building_avg_area_per_floor,
    SUM(fa.rooms) AS building_rooms
  FROM floors_agg fa
  GROUP BY fa.BUILDING_KEY
),
per_floor_rows AS (
  SELECT
    f.BUILDING_KEY,
    f.FLOOR AS floor_key,
    f.rooms,
    f.total_area,
    0 AS is_subtotal,
    1 AS sort_group,
    -- sorting floor: numeric floors first by numeric value, then non-numeric by text
    CASE WHEN f.FLOOR REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN LPAD(f.FLOOR,10,'0') ELSE CONCAT('Z',f.FLOOR) END AS sort_floor
  FROM floors_agg f
),
per_building_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    bt.BUILDING_KEY,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS floor_key,
    bt.building_rooms AS rooms,
    bt.building_total_area AS total_area,
    1 AS is_subtotal,
    2 AS sort_group,
    '9999' AS sort_floor
  FROM building_totals bt
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS BUILDING_KEY,
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS floor_key,
    SUM(bt.building_rooms) AS rooms,
    SUM(bt.building_total_area) AS total_area,
    2 AS is_subtotal,
    3 AS sort_group,
    '99999' AS sort_floor,
    SUM(bt.building_floor_count) AS total_floor_count
  FROM building_totals bt
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT * FROM per_floor_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM per_building_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, floor_key, rooms, total_area, is_subtotal, sort_group, sort_floor FROM grand_total
)
SELECT
  u.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  u.floor_key AS FLOOR_KEY,
  -- formatted ROOM_COUNT and TOTAL_AREA
  FORMAT(ROUND(u.rooms),0) AS ROOM_COUNT,
  FORMAT(ROUND(u.total_area),0) AS TOTAL_AREA,
  -- AVG_AREA_PER_FLOOR:
  CASE
    WHEN u.floor_key = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN FORMAT(ROUND(bt.building_avg_area_per_floor),0)
    WHEN u.BUILDING_KEY = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN
      FORMAT(
        ROUND(
          CASE WHEN SUM(bt.building_floor_count) IS NULL OR SUM(bt.building_floor_count)=0 THEN 0
               ELSE SUM(bt.building_total_area)/SUM(bt.building_floor_count) END
        ,0)
      ,0)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS AVG_AREA_PER_FLOOR,
  -- BUILDING_NAME and ACCESS_LEVEL: blank for GRAND TOTAL (handled by join producing NULL)
  CASE WHEN u.BUILDING_KEY = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN NULL ELSE bi.BUILDING_NAME END AS BUILDING_NAME,
  CASE WHEN u.BUILDING_KEY = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN NULL
       ELSE COALESCE(bi.BUILDING_ACCESS_LEVEL,
                     (SELECT fr.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM fac_rooms_core fr WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY = u.BUILDING_KEY LIMIT 1),
                     '') END AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  -- ZIP_CODE and CITY only for floor rows (not subtotals or grand total)
  CASE WHEN u.floor_key NOT IN ('SUBTOTAL','GRAND TOTAL') THEN bi.ZIP_CODE ELSE NULL END AS ZIP_CODE,
  CASE WHEN u.floor_key NOT IN ('SUBTOTAL','GRAND TOTAL') THEN bi.CITY ELSE NULL END AS CITY
FROM unioned u
LEFT JOIN building_info bi ON bi.BUILDING_KEY = u.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_totals bt ON bt.BUILDING_KEY = u.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  -- needed for grand total avg computation: provide building_totals as rows for aggregation
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, building_total_area, building_floor_count FROM building_totals
) bt_all ON bt_all.BUILDING_KEY = bt.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_totals bt_sum_placeholder ON bt_sum_placeholder.BUILDING_KEY = bt.BUILDING_KEY
-- For computing grand total avg we will aggregate in the SELECT using building_totals via subselect
ORDER BY
  -- primary by building key ascending grouping, but keep sort_group to put SUBTOTAL after floors and GRAND TOTAL last
  CASE WHEN u.BUILDING_KEY = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 'ZZZZZZ' ELSE u.BUILDING_KEY END ASC,
  u.sort_group ASC,
  u.sort_floor ASC

  cat.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  COALESCE(i.distinct_catalog_isbns,0) AS distinct_catalog_isbns
FROM current_academic_term cat
JOIN course_catalog_subjects c
  ON c.TERM_CODE = cat.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (

    NULL AS dummy

    AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID
) i
  ON i.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
  AND i.SUBJECT_ID = c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID -- prefer master subject id link if present
WHERE cat.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'

  SELECT

rows.question: For each IAP category, list its name, number of unique sessions, total number of attendees, active period (in the format of 'beginning term code-end term code'), the most common sponsor name, and the most common session start time. Include a grand total row showing the total number of sessions and attendees across all categories in the format of ('TOTAL', number of sessions, number of attendees, null, null, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_session_rowlevel AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS SESSION_ID,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS CATEGORY_ID,
    d.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS SPONSOR_NAME,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME AS START_TIME,
    -- ATTENDANCE in iap_subject_detail appears to be the attendee count; treat as integer where possible
    CASE
      WHEN d.ATTENDANCE IS NULL OR d.ATTENDANCE = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(d.ATTENDANCE AS SIGNED)
    END AS ATTENDEE_COUNT
  FROM iap_subject_session s
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_sponsor sp
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
),
iap_category_master AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS CATEGORY_ID,
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME
  FROM iap_subject_category
),
category_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    CATEGORY_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SESSION_ID) AS num_unique_sessions,
    SUM(COALESCE(ATTENDEE_COUNT, 0)) AS total_attendees,
    MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term,
    MAX(TERM_CODE) AS max_term
  FROM iap_session_rowlevel
  WHERE CATEGORY_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CATEGORY_ID
),
most_common_sponsor AS (
  SELECT
    CATEGORY_ID,
    SPONSOR_NAME AS most_common_sponsor
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CATEGORY_ID,
      SPONSOR_NAME,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SPONSOR_NAME) AS rn
    FROM iap_session_rowlevel
    WHERE SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY CATEGORY_ID, SPONSOR_NAME
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
most_common_start_time AS (
  SELECT
    CATEGORY_ID,
    START_TIME AS most_common_start_time
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CATEGORY_ID,
      START_TIME,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, START_TIME) AS rn
    FROM iap_session_rowlevel
    WHERE START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY_ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY CATEGORY_ID, START_TIME
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  m.CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  COALESCE(a.num_unique_sessions, 0) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SESSIONS,
  COALESCE(a.total_attendees, 0) AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
  CASE WHEN a.num_unique_sessions > 0 THEN CONCAT(a.min_term, '-', a.max_term) ELSE NULL END AS ACTIVE_PERIOD,
  mcsp.most_common_sponsor AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
  mcst.most_common_start_time AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
FROM iap_category_master m
LEFT JOIN category_aggregates a ON m.CATEGORY_ID = a.CATEGORY_ID
LEFT JOIN most_common_sponsor mcsp ON m.CATEGORY_ID = mcsp.CATEGORY_ID
LEFT JOIN most_common_start_time mcst ON m.CATEGORY_ID = mcst.CATEGORY_ID

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  SUM(COALESCE(a.num_unique_sessions,0)) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SESSIONS,
  SUM(COALESCE(a.total_attendees,0)) AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
  NULL AS ACTIVE_PERIOD,
  NULL AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
  NULL AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
FROM category_aggregates a

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN CATEGORY_NAME = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  CATEGORY_NAME

rows.question: For each building type, list the name of the building type, the number of buildings that are not subdivisions, number of employees, number of unique building street address, number of unique city, number of unique state, number of unique postal code, and average gross square footage per employee. For building type of 'resident', display it as 'RESIDENTIAL'. Include a grand total across all building types (the corresponding type field is 'TOTAL').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH employees_by_office_location AS (
  SELECT
    MIT_ID,
    FULL_NAME,
    OFFICE_LOCATION,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM drupal_employee_directory
),
building_addresses_street AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    POSTAL_CODE,
    ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
    STREET_NUMBER,
    STREET_NAME,
    STREET_SUFFIX
  FROM fac_building_address
  WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
),
_buildings_core AS (
  /* Emulate FULL JOIN between fac_building and buildings on BUILDING_NUMBER */
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_TYPE,
    COALESCE(fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN buildings b ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    NULL AS BUILDING_TYPE,
    COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM buildings b
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
  WHERE fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL
),
employees_per_location AS (
  SELECT
    OFFICE_LOCATION,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS emp_cnt
  FROM employees_by_office_location
  WHERE OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL AND OFFICE_LOCATION <> ''
  GROUP BY OFFICE_LOCATION
),
building_address_flags AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    -- has any street rows
    MAX(1) AS has_street,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CITY) AS city_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT STATE) AS state_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT POSTAL_CODE) AS postal_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS(' ', STREET_NUMBER, STREET_NAME, STREET_SUFFIX)) AS street_addr_count
  FROM building_addresses_street
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
per_building AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(bc.BUILDING_TYPE,'')) = 'resident' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      WHEN bc.BUILDING_TYPE IS NULL OR bc.BUILDING_TYPE = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      ELSE UPPER(bc.BUILDING_TYPE)
    END AS building_type,
    bc.BUILDING_KEY,
    bc.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    1 AS non_subdivision_building_count,
    COALESCE(e.emp_cnt, 0) AS employee_count,
    COALESCE(baf.street_addr_count, 0) AS unique_street_address_count,
    COALESCE(baf.city_count, 0) AS unique_city_count,
    COALESCE(baf.state_count, 0) AS unique_state_count,
    COALESCE(baf.postal_count, 0) AS unique_postal_code_count,
    COALESCE(bc.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS total_gross_sqft
  FROM _buildings_core bc
  LEFT JOIN building_address_flags baf
    ON baf.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY OR baf.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_NUMBER
  LEFT JOIN employees_per_location e
    ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = bc.BUILDING_NUMBER OR e.OFFICE_LOCATION = bc.BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  building_type,
  SUM(non_subdivision_building_count) AS non_subdivision_building_count,
  SUM(employee_count) AS employee_count,
  SUM(unique_street_address_count) AS unique_street_address_count,
  SUM(unique_city_count) AS unique_city_count,
  SUM(unique_state_count) AS unique_state_count,
  SUM(unique_postal_code_count) AS unique_postal_code_count,
  CASE WHEN SUM(employee_count) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(SUM(total_gross_sqft) / SUM(employee_count), 2) END AS avg_gross_sqft_per_employee
FROM per_building
GROUP BY building_type

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS building_type,
  SUM(non_subdivision_building_count),
  SUM(employee_count),
  SUM(unique_street_address_count),
  SUM(unique_city_count),
  SUM(unique_state_count),
  SUM(unique_postal_code_count),
  CASE WHEN SUM(employee_count) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(SUM(total_gross_sqft) / SUM(employee_count), 2) END
FROM per_building

ORDER BY CASE WHEN building_type = 'TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, building_type

rows.question: List each organization's break group, ID, name, and formatted name according to its level, along with whether its members are emeritus or non-emeritus. Also, include the organization number, level, employer count, and hierarchy type for each organization. Exclude organizations '139' and '250'. Sort the results by hierarchy type and ensure totals for employer counts are displayed.

WITH organization_formatted_name_rules AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_4_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_5_CODE) AS ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '1' THEN 'PREFIX_SUFFIX'
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '2' THEN 'SUFFIX_ONLY'
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '3' THEN 'PREFIX_ONLY'
      WHEN master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'NO_CHANGE'
      ELSE 'NO_CHANGE'
    END AS FORMAT_TYPE,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '1' THEN ''
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '2' THEN ''
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '3' THEN ''
      ELSE ''
    END AS PREFIX,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '1' THEN ''
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '2' THEN ' Department'
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '3' THEN ''
      ELSE ''
    END AS SUFFIX,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '1' THEN 'TRIM({name})'
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '2' THEN 'CONCAT(TRIM({name}), '' Department'')'
      WHEN COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL) = '3' THEN 'CONCAT(''Program: '', TRIM({name}))'
      WHEN master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 'TRIM({name})'
      ELSE 'TRIM({name})'
    END AS TRANSFORM_SQL_SNIPPET
  FROM fac_organization
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization
    ON fac_organization.ORG_PARENT_KEY = fclt_organization.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN master_dept_hierarchy
    ON fac_organization.D_CODE = master_dept_hierarchy.DLC_CODE
  WHERE COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_4_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_5_CODE) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(fac_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fclt_organization.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_4_CODE, master_dept_hierarchy.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_5_CODE)
),
organization_core AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(f.`ORGANIZATION_ID`, fo.`ORGANIZATION_ID`) AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
    COALESCE(f.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`, fo.`ORGANIZATION_NUMBER`) AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(f.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`, fo.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`) AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    COALESCE(f.`ORGANIZATION_LEVEL`, fo.`ORGANIZATION_LEVEL`) AS ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
    m.`HIERARCHY_TYPE` AS HIERARCHY_TYPE,
    m.`DLC_CODE` AS BREAK_GROUP
  FROM fac_organization f
  LEFT JOIN fclt_organization fo
    ON f.`ORGANIZATION_ID` = fo.`ORGANIZATION_ID`
  LEFT JOIN master_dept_hierarchy m
    ON m.`DLC_CODE` = f.`D_CODE`
)
SELECT
  oc.BREAK_GROUP AS break_group,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_ID AS org_id,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS org_name,
  -- build formatted_name using rules; handle NULL rule by defaulting to name
  CASE
    WHEN ofnr.FORMAT_TYPE = 'PREFIX_SUFFIX' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(ofnr.PREFIX, ''), IF(COALESCE(ofnr.PREFIX, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') <> '', ' ', ''), COALESCE(oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), IF(COALESCE(ofnr.SUFFIX, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') <> '', ' ', ''), COALESCE(ofnr.SUFFIX, ''))
    WHEN ofnr.FORMAT_TYPE = 'SUFFIX_ONLY' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''), IF(COALESCE(ofnr.SUFFIX, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') <> '', ' ', ''), COALESCE(ofnr.SUFFIX, ''))
    WHEN ofnr.FORMAT_TYPE = 'PREFIX_ONLY' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(ofnr.PREFIX, ''), IF(COALESCE(ofnr.PREFIX, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '') <> '', ' ', ''), COALESCE(oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ''))
    ELSE COALESCE(oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, '')
  END AS formatted_name,
  -- emeritus status: we consider IS_FACULTY = 'Emeritus' as emeritus; else Non-Emeritus.
  CASE WHEN opc.IS_FACULTY = 'Emeritus' THEN 'Emeritus' ELSE 'Non-Emeritus' END AS emeritus_status,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS organization_number,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS level,
  COUNT(opc.MIT_ID) AS employer_count,
  oc.HIERARCHY_TYPE AS hierarchy_type
FROM organization_core oc
LEFT JOIN organization_formatted_name_rules ofnr
  ON oc.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = ofnr.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL
LEFT JOIN opa_person_current opc
  ON opc.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = oc.ORGANIZATION_ID
WHERE oc.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('139','250')
GROUP BY
  oc.BREAK_GROUP,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  formatted_name,
  emeritus_status,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  oc.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  oc.HIERARCHY_TYPE
ORDER BY oc.HIERARCHY_TYPE, oc.BREAK_GROUP, oc.ORGANIZATION_ID

rows.question: For each course, list its title, name of the building of the course location, duration (in terms of days), and a running average of the duration (in terms of days) using a window of two preceding and two following courses (partitioned by academic year and sorted by course start date).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_by_number AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`,
    `BUILDING_KEY`
  FROM `buildings`
),
course_section_basic AS (
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE,
    c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, c.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    c.SECTION_ID,
    c.MEET_PLACE
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` c
  WHERE c.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
),
term_dates_by_term_code AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_START_DATE`,
    `TERM_END_DATE`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`
  FROM `academic_terms`
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE) AS course_title,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  CAST(
    (TO_DAYS(STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'))
     - TO_DAYS(STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')))
    AS SIGNED
  ) AS duration_days,
  AVG(
    CAST(
      (TO_DAYS(STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'))
       - TO_DAYS(STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')))
      AS DECIMAL(10,2)
    )
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
    ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
  ) AS running_avg_duration_days
FROM course_section_basic cs
JOIN term_dates_by_term_code t
  ON cs.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN building_by_number b
  ON cs.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE t.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
  AND t.TERM_END_DATE IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
  AND b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
         STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')
